title: Expert - Talent Acquisition
description:
**Job Title: Expert \- Talent Acquisition (**Business Support)


**Job Location:** Mumbai


In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape our workforce across the GSC centers while being physically present in India. With a focus on international recruitment, excellent communication skills, sourcing skills and a commitment to delivering exceptional talent, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening our brand image and driving our continued success.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Collaborate closely with hiring managers across the GSC centers to understand and align talent needs, ensuring a deep understanding of position requirements, target audience and timelines.
* Employ innovative and strategic sourcing techniques, leveraging a variety of channels such as LinkedIn, job boards, professional networks, and international recruitment platforms to identify and engage passive and active candidates.
* Conduct comprehensive interviews and thorough candidate assessments to evaluate qualifications, skills, and cultural fit.
* Drive the candidate journey by managing applicant tracking, maintaining accurate candidate records, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
* Provide expert guidance, training, and support to hiring managers and stakeholders throughout the recruitment process.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and best practices, continuously enhancing your knowledge and expertise in talent acquisition.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

Experience 7\+ years


* Proven experience in Global recruitment, preferably within the logistics industry, with a focus on hiring across the GSC centers.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with candidates, hiring managers, team members and stakeholders across diverse cultural backgrounds to foster collaborative relationships
* Strong strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities, enabling you to develop and implement targeted sourcing strategies that attract top talent.
* Proficiency in utilizing various recruitment tools and platforms, including applicant tracking systems, job boards, social media, and online networking platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining attention to detail and meeting tight deadlines.
* Passion for delivering exceptional customer service, ensuring a positive candidate experience at every touchpoint.
* CIR, CSSR, CSMR certifications are preferred

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a result\-oriented Sales Manager to own the process right from connecting first time on call to the , **site\-visit\-to\-booking journey** for Little Konkan Farm.

The role requires strong customer handling, consultative selling, objection management, follow\-up discipline and the ability to convert genuine prospects into bookings.

This is a **frontline sales ownership role**, not simply a site\-visiting/showing role.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer \& Site Visit Management**

* Handle assigned high\-intent prospects/Leads and confirmed site visits.
* Reconfirm every visit in advance and understand customer budget, requirement, decision\-makers and buying timeline.
* Conduct professional site visits at Little Konkan Farm, Kolad.
* Understand whether the customer is buying for farming, weekend use, investment, retirement, second home, lifestyle or land banking.
* Present suitable plot options based on size, budget, location, access, terrain and intended use.
* Build customer confidence through transparent and accurate communication.

**Sales Conversion**

* Convert site visits into defined next steps, booking, token, document review, revisit or commercial discussion.
* Handle objections around distance, road access, agricultural zoning, documentation, title, pricing, water, electricity, maintenance and future potential.
* Identify serious buyers versus low\-intent prospects.
* Maintain structured follow\-up until closure or a clearly defined outcome.
* Generate referrals and additional opportunities from existing customers.

**Coordination \& Documentation**

* Coordinate booking forms, KYC, payment schedules and documentation with the relevant teams.
* Follow up on customer collections as per committed schedules.
* Coordinate with, marketing, documentation and site teams to ensure a seamless customer journey.
* Escalate pricing, legal, and inventory, transport or customer\-service issues promptly.

**CRM \& Reporting**

* Maintain 100% accurate CRM records.
* Update every call, visit, and follow\-up and customer outcome on the same working day.
* Maintain a clear next\-action date for every active prospect.
* Share daily activity updates and weekly sales forecasts.
* Track individual funnel performance from site visit through booking.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Site\-visit attendance / show\-up rate
* Site visit → booking conversion
* Monthly bookings
* Revenue generated
* Follow\-up completion
* CRM accuracy and same\-day updating
* Revisit conversion
* Collection follow\-up
* Customer referrals
* Customer experience and compliance

**Ideal Candidate**

* 3–5 years of experience in real\-estate, plotted development, land, farm plots, villas, second homes or high\-ticket sales.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Comfortable conducting sales discussions independently.
* Able to handle customers and family decision\-makers confidently.
* Strong follow\-up discipline.
* Commercially driven and comfortable with targets.
* Good CRM discipline.
* Willing to travel to Kolad for customer visits.
* Must be comfortable working with customers beyond conventional office hours when required by the sales cycle.

**What We Expect**

We are looking for someone who does not simply **show the property**.

We want someone who can **understand the buyer, build trust, handle objections, create urgency appropriately and close the next step.**

**The primary measure of success is not the number of customers spoken to \- it is the quality of the funnel and the bookings generated from genuine opportunities.**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Commercial Manager
description:
Overview:

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

  

Are you ready to love your job?

  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**PURPOSE**


Collaborates on the commercial management of complex tailored standard renewal and new business deals. Contributes to the management of commercial activities policy and process in support of renewal or new standard business deals. Ensures Financial profitability compliance to financial and business objectives while supporting business growth.

 **What will you do:**

**Commercial Strategy \& Deal Structuring**

* Collaborate with sales and business development stakeholders to design commercial strategies for complex tailored renewals and new business.
* Develop commercial model structures (including currency, tax, and billing), competitive pricing positioning, and negotiation strategies for non\-standard terms.
* Represent SITA as the commercial authority on terms and conditions to both internal executives and client leadership.
* Advocate for and drive the optimum financial viability of engagements within the context of the total contract structure.

**Financial Modelling \& Risk Management**

* Provide comprehensive financial modelling for deal opportunities, analysing pricing structures, CAPEX, cash flow, and their impacts on commercial terms.
* Review proposals alongside stakeholders to evaluate the financial framework, contractual terms, regulatory compliance, delivery, and full lifecycle issues.
* Identify, quantify, assess, and report risks associated with bids as part of the deal team.

**Negotiation \& Contract Management**

* Negotiate commercially and financially sound contracts directly with customers to ensure mutual, long\-term value throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Support the development of pricing proposals and contract drafts for complex tailored standard renewals and new business deals.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Governance**

* Align commercial aspects with technical solutions and limitations by working closely with SITA's technical and solution communities.
* Collaborate proactively with the wider deal team, including bid, contract, and solution colleagues.
* Ensure all commercial activities comply with company regulations, including governance, bid processes, and delegation of authority.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**

* 5\+ years of experience in similar roles where **financial and mathematical modelling** is required
* Preferably having worked in a multinational company

 **KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**

* Excellent communication skills
* Proven ability to work in multiple high\-priority tasks at once
* Detail oriented
* High degree of proficiency in Excel ? better than average
* Knowledge on database MS office (Word PowerPoint)
* Basic knowledge on database usage
* Customer centric focus
* Willingness to work in a cross\-functional and cross\-culture team environment
* Highly organized to achieve objectives with the strong ability to convey complex information to its peers who may not be technical or financial oriented.
* Knowledge of Information Technology and Telecommunications is a plus

 **PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**

* Accuracy and Attention to Detail
* Business Data Analysis
* Business Markets
* Commercial Acumen
* Contracts Review
* Cost\-Benefit Analysis
* Cross\-team integration
* Financial Analysis
* Graphic Tools
* Negotiating
* Networking
* Partnering for Clients' Success
* Planning: Tactical Strategic
* RFP experience
* Sales Closing and Agreements
* Storytelling
* Technical Writing/Documentation

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Adhering to Principles \& Values
* Communication
* Creating \& Innovating
* Customer Focus
* Developing Talent
* Impact \& Influence
* Leading Execution
* Managing Performance
* Results Orientation
* Teamwork

**EDUCATION \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Quantitative analysis background, Degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or Economics fields

 **WHAT WE OFFER**

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex\-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

  

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. title: AVP-Messaging Operations
description:
Chat Operations Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing the performance of customer service team focused on chat interactions. This role drives the achievement of key digital customer service indicators (KPIs), ensures efficient handling of chat volumes, and maintains a consistently high\-quality customer experience across all chat channels. The manager will lead, develop, and mentor their agents, implement strategic initiatives for chat operations, and foster a culture of digital excellence and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Operational Leadership: Oversee the daily operations of customer service team, ensuring optimal staffing, efficient chat queue management, and adherence to digital communication policies and procedures.
* Performance Management: Establish, monitor, and achieve critical chat\-specific customer service KPIs, including Average Response Time (ART), Concurrent Chat Handling, Chat Abandonment Rate, Quality Assurance (QA) scores for written interactions, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) in digital channels. Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.
* Team Development \& Coaching: Lead, coach, and mentor team members focusing on effective written communication, tone, multi\-tasking skills in a chat environment, and efficient use of chat tools and resources. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify development opportunities.
* Strategy \& Planning: Contribute to the strategic development and execution of digital customer service initiatives, including integrating new chat technologies, optimizing chat flows, and exploring AI/chatbot synergies to improve efficiency and customer experience.
* Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement within chat operations, implement best practices for digital engagement, streamline chat processes (e.g., template usage, knowledge base integration), and reduce resolution times. Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Technology, Bot team and Quality Assurance to ensure seamless integration of chat channels and alignment with overall business goals.
* Reporting \& Analysis: Analyze chat interaction data, generate comprehensive reports on team performance, chat trends, and bot performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision\-making.
* Issue Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues encountered via chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution while upholding service standards.
* Compliance \& Risk Management: Ensure all chat operations comply with internal policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements pertaining to digital communication and data privacy. Identify and mitigate potential operational risks
* Projects \& Initiatives: Lead and participate in various projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the chat platform, introducing new features, improving agent tools, or integrating with other digital channels to elevate the overall digital customer experience.


**Qualifications:**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree preferred.
* Experience: Minimum of 10\+ years of progressive experience in customer service operations, with at least 6\+ years in a leadership role managing customer service team (people manager)
* Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment and manage multiple digital priorities effectively.
* Leadership Skills: Strong leadership, motivational, and coaching abilities, with a track record of developing high\-performing teams in a digital context.
* Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret digital interaction data, identify trends, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Communication: Exceptional written communication skills, with a keen understanding of digital communication etiquette, brand voice, and clarity. Strong verbal communication for internal leadership.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficient in chat management systems, knowledge base systems, and familiarity with AI/chatbot technologies. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.


**Desired Attributes:**
* Strategic thinker with an ability to anticipate future trends in digital customer service.
* Proactive and results\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership over digital channels.
* Ability to inspire and influence others towards achieving digital excellence.
* High level of integrity and professionalism.

title: Sales Manager Business Development India
description:
**Job Description**
* Purpose of the Position


 Drive the strategic development and sustainable growth of the Indian market in order to achieve and expand revenue, sales volume and profitability targets. Identify and realize new business opportunities while building long\-term customer and partner relationships to strengthen the company's market position within the Indian automotive industry.
   

  

* Main Responsibilities


**Sales Manager / Business Development Manager India**
* Develop and implement market entry and growth strategies for the Indian market.
* Identify and evaluate new business opportunities and customer prospects within the automotive electric industry (harnesses).
* Analyze market, competitor, technology and industry trends and derive strategic recommendations.
* Build and further develop a strong network with OEMs, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, as well as other relevant stakeholders in India.
* Identify, approach and acquire key decision\-makers in purchasing, engineering and management functions.
* Establish and maintain sustainable customer relationships to generate new projects and series production business.
* Take ownership of developing and maintaining a qualified sales opportunity pipeline.
* Identify, generate and pursue RFQs, development projects and serial production opportunities.
* Coordinate and manage all acquisition activities up to successful contract award.
* Ensure the definition and alignment of acquisition requirements, customer specifications and commercial frameworks.
* Ensure the preparation of quotations, business cases, cost breakdowns and profitability analyses in close cooperation with relevant internal departments.
* Negotiate commercial and contractual terms and conditions within approved authorization levels.
* Ensure achievement of agreed revenue, order intake and profitability targets.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with industry associations, governmental bodies, economic institutions and other relevant stakeholders.
* Represent the company at customer events, trade fairs, conferences and industry forums.
* Closely collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Purchasing and Project Management to ensure successful execution of customer requirements.
* Support customer projects from initial business acquisition through series production launch.
* Ensure regular forecasting, pipeline management, market analysis and sales reporting.
* Contribute to the continuous development of the company's international sales strategy with a focus on India.
* Act as the primary interface between Indian customers and international company functions.
* Special Authorities
* Signing authority in accordance with the applicable corporate signature policy.
* Represent the company towards customers, business partners, associations and institutions within the assigned area of responsibility.
* Conduct commercial, contractual and pricing negotiations within defined approval and delegation limits.
* Workplace Requirements
* Standard office equipment (laptop, mobile phone, communication and presentation tools).
* High willingness to travel internationally, particularly within India and between India and Europe.
* Professional Requirements


**Education**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a comparable qualification.


**Professional Experience**
* 5 to 10 years of experience in Sales, Key Account Management or Business Development.
* Proven track record in developing new markets and business opportunities.
* Several years of experience within the Indian market.
* Experience in the automotive industry, preferably in Electrical/Electronic Systems,.
* Experience working with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.


**Additional Qualifications**
* Fluent business English, both written and spoken.
* Strong understanding of the Indian automotive market, business environment and industry structures.
* Existing network within Indian OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers is highly desirable.
* Hindi or additional regional Indian language skills are considered an advantage.
* German language skills are beneficial.


**Competencies According to the DRÄXLMAIER Competency Model and Career Path**
**Nature of Work**
* Design and develop market development and business growth strategies to address complex and emerging market requirements.
* Create innovative approaches for capturing new business opportunities based on comprehensive customer, market and competitive analyses.


**Scope of Responsibility**
* High degree of autonomy in developing and expanding the Indian market within defined strategic objectives.
* Independent planning, prioritization and execution of sales and business development activities.
* Performance measured primarily against agreed revenue, order intake and market development objectives.


**Key Success Factors**
* Proven ability to establish strong customer relationships with Indian OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.
* Successful acquisition of new customers, development projects and serial production business.
* Sustainable growth of order intake and revenue within the Indian market.
* Development and management of a robust sales opportunity pipeline.
* Successful execution of defined market development and growth milestones.
* Strong intercultural competence and ability to bridge Indian customer requirements with European organizational structures and processes.


 We are looking forward to your application.

 We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Client Processing Manager to join our Global Transfer Agency team. This role is located in Pune.

* Own the end\-to\-end Trade processing until settlement, including task allocation, controls, quality, and risk management

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or related field required.
* Advanced degree or professional certifications in finance or business administration preferred.
* Typically 8\+ years of experience in Transfer Agency or related field within financial services.
* Good experience of Trade processing, reconciliation, client service and people management required.
* Strong leadership and collaboration skills across diverse teams, with excellent interpersonal skills for client interactions.
* Experience in holding teams responsible to department KRI’s and undertaking annual performance reviews with teams.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager with 8 to 12 years of experience in the payments industry to drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of innovative digital products. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in credit and debit card ecosystems, issuer and processor models, account\-level data management, and modern digital product development. In this role, you will collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, operations, marketing, and customer experience teams to define product vision, identify market opportunities, and deliver customer\-centric payment solutions. You will play a key role in shaping product strategy, optimizing customer experiences, and enabling data\-driven decision\-making across the product ecosystem.

* **Role: Senior Product Manager**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Define and execute product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with organizational goals and customer needs.
* Lead end\-to\-end product lifecycle management from ideation, discovery, and design through development, launch, and post\-launch optimization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, architecture, operations, sales, marketing, compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Gather and prioritize product requirements based on customer feedback, market trends, competitive analysis, and business objectives.
* Manage and maintain product backlogs using Agile methodologies and product management best practices.
* Create detailed product requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specifications.
* Drive innovations across payment products involving credit cards, debit cards, transaction processing, and customer engagement capabilities.
* Analyze account\-level customer data to develop segmentation, personalization, customer targeting, and engagement strategies.
* Define data\-driven product enhancements that improve customer acquisition, retention, and transaction growth.
* Partner with engineering teams to design API\-driven and microservices\-based product capabilities.

description:
**.jobDisplayShell { max\-width:** 1000px !important; }
  
  

Hungry for challenges? Join a group with innovation at its heart and contribute to the automotive revolution!
  
  

OPmobility is a world\-leading provider of innovative solutions for a unique, safer and more sustainable mobility experience. Innovation\-driven since its creation, the Group develops and produces intelligent exterior systems, customized complex modules, lighting systems, clean energy systems and electrification solutions for all mobility companies. With a €11\.4 billion economic revenue in 2023, a global network of 152 plants and 40 R\&D centers, OPmobility relies on its 40,300 employees to meet the challenges of transforming mobility.
  
  

Our ambition? Provide automakers with cutting\-edge equipment and solutions to develop tomorrow’s clean and connected car.
  
  

As part of the Global IS Operations Team, the Regional IS operations Manager for APAC is responsible to
  
  

Manage IS Operations service delivery within the APAC region, in coordination with Global IS Product Operation Manager and Central Services Teams, ensuring operational stability, performance, and customer satisfaction.
  
Act as the primary regional contact for major incident management, urgent standard change coordination, SLA/KPI tracking, and communication.
  
Manage the alignment of APAC regional operations with global governance and contributes to the Build\-to\-Run transition for projects and evolutions.
  
  

He/she promotes and support the deployment of Group IS/IT policies, standards, and procedures at APAC level and drives operational excellence and continuous improvement of IT services delivered in the APAC region, identifying risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities in operational processes.
  
  

**Main activities:**  

**Support and Corrective maintenance:**  

Oversee and manage major IS incidents impacting the APAC region, ensuring rapid response, escalation, and resolution.
  
Act as the IS APAC escalation point for critical incidents and service disruptions.
  
Maintain clear communication with stakeholders throughout incident lifecycle (major incident bridge management).
  
Ensure effective IS post\-incident reviews and root cause analysis follow\-up.
  
Provide regular reporting on IS incident metrics, SLA breaches, and corrective action plans (in coordination with IS Product Operation manager and Central Services Teams).
  
  

**Administration \& Supervision:**  

Ensure APAC project and evolution handovers are executed following the Build\-to\-Run framework.
  
Support local testing, acceptance, and onboarding of new services into operations.
  
Manage relationships with external vendors and service partners at APAC level (in coordination with IS Product Operation Manager and Central Services Teams).
  
Monitor and optimize APAC IS resources to support operational efficiency (in coordination with IS Product Operation Manager and Central Services Teams).
  
  

**Standard Change Management:**  

Manage urgent standard changes within the APAC region, ensuring risk assessment, coordination, and timely execution.
  
Validate APAC operational readiness for change implementations.
  
Ensure all changes follow Group IT/IS governance, approval, and documentation standards.
  
Support communication and scheduling changes with affected Business.
  
Track and report regional change performance, identifying areas for improvement.
  
  

**Required profile and experience:**  

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  
ITIL V3 or 4 certification (Service Operations or Service Management) preferred.
  
Project Management or Service Delivery Management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2\) is an advantage.
  
At least 6–8 years of IT Operations experience, including 3 years in service delivery management.
  
Proven experience managing SLAs and KPIs in a regional or global IS service context.
  
Demonstrated success in coordinating Build\-to\-Run transitions and operational readiness.
  
Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes: Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management.
  
Familiarity with ERP (SAP), Integration platforms (EDI, Boomi), and Digital Solutions
  
Experience with monitoring and ticketing tools (ServiceNow, EasyVista, JIRA, etc.).
  
Fluent English
  
  

Key behavioral skills
  
  

Excellent communication and escalation management skills.
  
Customer\-oriented and proactive in stakeholder engagement.
  
Strong analytical, prioritization, and leadership skills.
  
Capable of working effectively in multicultural and cross\-functional environments.
  
  

As a responsible company, OPmobility pays particular attention to diversity and equality within its teams and the Group commits to treat all job applications equally.

Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. **WHO YOU ARE** 
  

 • You have at least 5 years of leadership experience in a customer\-focused, fast paced, and multi\-channel retail environment.
   

 • You are passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and driving business growth through operational excellence.

 • You have a good understanding of legal compliance, third\-party contracts, safety and security requirements, and can work confidently with external authorities when required.
   

 • You have knowledge of the food business, including food safety standards and commercial operations.
   

 • You are analytical, collaborative, and an effective communicator who builds strong relationships across functions to deliver business results.
   

  

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 
  

 • Lead the Customer Experience function by creating a seamless, convenient, and rewarding shopping journey across all customer touchpoints.
   

 • Drive a customer\-first culture by using customer insights, feedback, and market trends to improve the overall shopping experience and influence business decisions.
   

 • Ensure operational excellence by identifying and removing barriers that impact customers throughout their buying, checkout, payment, and after\-sales journey.
   

 • Support commercial priorities and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to maximize sales, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
   

 • Oversee the IKEA Food business, ensuring commercial success while maintaining the highest standards of food safety, Swedishness, and regulatory compliance.
   

 • Develop and implement customer service, food business, and operational action plans aligned with local, national, and global business objectives.
   

 • Ensure compliance with IKEA policies, legal requirements, food safety regulations, and operational best practices.
   

 • Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external partners to enhance operational efficiency and protect the IKEA culture and values.
   

 • Plan and manage departmental resources, budgets, and investments to achieve operational and financial targets.
   

 • Lead, coach, and develop team members by setting clear goals, supporting individual growth, and building a strong succession pipeline.
   

 • Analyze customer, consumer, brand, and operational data to provide recommendations that improve customer experience and business performance.
   

 • Champion continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the implementation of customer experience and retail food strategies across the store.
   

 • Ensure a safe environment for customers and co\-workers by promoting safety, security, and compliance across all operations.
   

 • Foster collaboration across commercial and support functions to deliver integrated and consistent customer experience across all channels.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 At IKEA it’s all about our customers, and in Customer Relations we build and retain long\-lasting relationships with new and existing customers in a multichannel retail environment. Our modus operandi is to connect to people by listening to their personal needs and to create genuine interactions. We’re a bunch of people who are truly passionate about people!
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application. From: "Why Women Don't Apply for Jobs Unless They're 100% Qualified" by Tara Sophia Mohr, August 2014"

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Job Description – Customer Success Manager (CSM)**
**Company:** 
 Aliste Technology
   

  

**Department:** 
 Customer Success
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Customer Success Manager
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Noida
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Head of Customer Success / Head of Support
   

  

**About Aliste Technology**
 Aliste Technology is a smart\-metering and energy\-technology company helping property owners and operators manage electricity consumption, metering, billing and collections more efficiently.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **high\-ownership Customer Success Manager** 
 who can manage assigned clients/properties end\-to\-end and ensure that customers receive consistent service, operational issues are resolved quickly, and properties remain healthy and retained.
   

  

**Role Objective**
 The CSM will be the
 **primary owner of assigned client accounts/properties** 
 after onboarding.
   

  

**The Person Will Be Responsible For**
* Maintaining strong client relationships.
* Ensuring smooth onboarding and installation.
* Monitoring property health and meter performance.
* Driving resolution of grievances and escalations.
* Coordinating with Operations, CCE, Sales and Finance.
* Monitoring outstanding payments and supporting collections.
* Reducing property churn/drop.
* Driving Auto\-Pay and Partner App adoption.
* Conducting regular client reviews.
* Identifying risks before they become escalations.
* Maintaining accurate CRM/Zoho and reporting data.


 The CSM is expected to
 **own the problem until closure** 
 , rather than simply forwarding it to another team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client \& Account Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build strong professional relationships with property owners, operators and key stakeholders.
* Understand each property's business requirements and operational challenges.
* Conduct regular client calls and meetings.
* Maintain proper records of all important client discussions.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Property Health Management


 The CSM should continuously monitor the health of assigned properties, including:
   

  

* Number of active meters.
* Offline meters.
* Installation pendency.
* Replacement pendency.
* Grievances and unresolved tickets.
* Over\-consumption complaints.
* Billing\-related issues.
* Low\-voltage and technical complaints.
* User/deduction\-related issues.
* Outstanding payments.
* Client dissatisfaction/escalation.
* Property drop/churn risk.


 The objective should be
 **zero surprise escalations** 
 —the CSM should identify risks before the client raises them.
   

  

* Grievance \& Escalation Management
* Monitor all open grievances on a daily basis.
* Ensure tickets are progressing within defined TAT/SLA.
* Coordinate with Operations and CCE teams for resolution.
* Follow up with technicians where required.
* Ensure "Under Review" cases are actively followed up and not left unattended.
* Personally handle critical client escalations.
* Keep clients updated until final resolution.
* Ensure closure is properly documented in Zoho.
* Installation \& Operational Coordination
* Coordinate with Operations for new installations.
* Track installation pendency and ageing.
* Ensure technicians complete assigned work properly.
* Ensure final checking/closure processes are followed.
* Coordinate re\-visits wherever genuinely required.
* Ensure client communication happens during important operational activities.
* Identify recurring operational issues and escalate them to management.
* Customer Retention


 The CSM will be directly responsible for reducing customer churn.

title: Lead Engineer-Physical Design
description:
Lead / Principal Physical Design Engineer (Team Lead) Location: Ahmedabad, India (Sasken Silicon) Function: ASIC Backend / Physical Design Reports to: PD Engineering Manager / Silicon Delivery Head Team: Leads a pod of ~10 juniorto–mid PD engineers (PD, STA, DFT, PV) Engagement context: Advanced-node (Intel 18A / sub-3nm) backend programs Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Physical Design lead to own the backend implementation of a high-performance digital IP on an advanced process node, from synthesis through tapeout-ready GDS-II. Beyond hands-on technical depth, this person must be able to lead and grow a team of ~10 junior PD engineers — distributing work, reviewing quality, unblocking the team, and driving convergence against tight QoR and schedule targets. This is a delivery-ownership role: the lead is accountable for floorplan strategy, timing/power/area closure, signoff quality, and on-time tapeout, while mentoring less-experienced engineers to operate at advanced-node standards. Key Responsibilities Technical ownership Own the full RTL-to-GDS physical design flow: synthesis, floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and signoff. Define floorplan and power-delivery strategy, including advanced-node considerations such as backside power delivery (PowerVia) and gate-all-around / RibbonFET cell handling where applicable. Drive timing closure across all PVT corners (MMMC, AOCV/POCV), including setup/hold, signal integrity, and complex timing ECOs. Own physical verification closure (DRC/LVS, antenna, PERC), power/EM/IR integrity, and thermal / self-heating (SHE) signoff. Manage memory and macro integration (e.g., large SRAM arrays), congestion management, and high pin-density datapath closure. Set up and validate the PD flow on a new PDK, including tool/flow bring-up and "pipe-clean" trial runs. Team leadership (critical) Lead a pod of ~10 junior PD engineers: assign blocks/tasks, set technical direction, and balance load dynamically across project phases. Review the team's work — floorplans, timing reports, signoff results — and enforce quality gates before handoff. Mentor and upskill junior engineers on advanced-node methodology, debugging, and tool usage. Run review-gate checkpoints (floorplan signoff, CTS targets, release candidates) and present status, risks, and QoR to internal and customer stakeholders. Coordinate handoffs with RTL/DV, DFT, and PV/signoff specialists, and drive rapid issue resolution on ECOs and debug requests. Required Qualifications Education: B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, VLSI, or related field. Experience: 10+ years in ASIC physical design, with a strong track record of taping out production silicon. (Adjust per band: ~8+ for Lead, ~12+ for Principal.) Team experience: Demonstrated experience leading/mentoring a team of PD engineers and owning delivery for a block or full chip — not just individual-contributor work. Full-flow depth: Hands-on ownership across synthesis, PnR, CTS, routing, STA, and physical/electrical signoff. Advanced-node experience: Proven work at 7nm/5nm/3nm or below; FinFET closure mandatory, gate-all-around / advanced-node exposure a strong plus. Tools: Strong hands-on with the Synopsys + Siemens flow used on this program: Synthesis & PnR: Synopsys Fusion Compiler (or Design Compiler + ICC2) Timing: Synopsys PrimeTime (incl. SI / ECO) Extraction: Synopsys StarRC Formal/LEC: Synopsys Formality Physical verification: Siemens Calibre (nmDRC, nmLVS, PERC, multi-patterning) DFT: Siemens Tessent (scan, MemoryBIST, boundary scan) Power/IR/EM: Ansys RedHawk-SC (Cadence Innovus/Tempus/Quantus exposure is a plus for flow flexibility.) Methodology: Solid grasp of low-power design (multi-Vt, clock/power gating, multi-voltage domains), CDC handling, DFT integration, and signoff-quality QoR metrics (WNS/TNS, 0-violation DRC/LVS, EM, thermal). Scripting: TCL and Python (Perl a plus) for flow automation and productivity. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Direct experience on Intel 18A (RibbonFET, PowerVia / backside power) or another foundry's gate-all-around / backside-power node. Experience on high-throughput DSP / wireless / MIMO datapaths, systolic arrays, or large matrix-compute blocks. Experience working with foundry PDKs at early maturity (PDK 0.9/1.0) and managing flow risk on evolving RTL. Experience operating in a fixed-timeline, milestone/review-gate delivery model with customer-facing checkpoints. Familiarity with HPC compute environments (large-RAM nodes) for advanced-node layouts. What Success Looks Like (First 6–9 Months) Stands up and validates the PD flow on the target PDK and completes a clean trial run. Locks a floorplan and power-grid strategy that clears the first review gate. Brings the pod of ~10 engineers to predictable, reviewable output with consistent quality. Drives the design to a tapeout-ready, 0-violation GDS-II within the agreed schedule. Core Competencies We Screen For Technical depth at advanced nodes and the leadership maturity to run a 10-person team. Ability to break a large backend program into block-level tasks and delegate effectively. Calm, structured problem-solving under schedule pressure. Clear communication of status, risk, and trade-offs to both engineers and stakeholders.

title: Gimbal Design Engineer
description:
Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented Gimbal Hardware Engineer with strong expertise in electromechanical integration, hardware design, and ruggedized system development. The ideal candidate will focus on the physical and electrical hardware aspects of gimbal systems, ensuring reliability in harsh environmental conditions. This role is suited for a hands-on hardware specialist who excels in connectors, harnessing, sealing, thermal management, and system-level integration of gimbal subsystems. Key Responsibilities Hardware Design & Integration Design and develop robust hardware architecture for 2-axis/3-axis gimbal systems. Integrate motors, sensors, cameras, PCBs, and wiring subsystems into compact and reliable assemblies. Ensure proper mechanical-electrical interfacing, grounding, and shielding practices. Connectors, Harness & Wiring Select and validate connectors (circular, micro-D, board-to-board, rugged connectors) based on application requirements. Design and develop wiring harnesses, including routing, strain relief, and serviceability. Ensure compliance with communication protocol harness standards for: o UART, RS232, RS485 o Ethernet / IP-based systems o Video signal transmission (HDMI, LVDS, MIPI, etc.) Perform signal integrity and EMI/EMC considerations in harness design. Environmental Protection & Sealing Design systems to meet IP ratings (IP65/IP67/IP68) for dust and water resistance. Select and implement gaskets, O-rings, sealing compounds, and potting materials. Ensure proper waterproofing and environmental sealing across enclosures, connectors, and cable interfaces. Collaborate on shock, vibration, and environmental robustness requirements. Thermal Management Analyze and implement thermal solutions including: 1) Heatsinks. 2) Thermal pads and interface materials. 3) Passive cooling strategies Ensure optimal heat dissipation for motors, electronics, and embedded systems. Motor & Hardware Component Selection Select appropriate gimbal motors (BLDC / torque motors) based on mechanical and electrical constraints. Evaluate hardware components such as fasteners, brackets, housings, and mounting interfaces. Understand mechanical load paths and ensure structural integrity. Testing & Validation Conduct hardware validation tests, including: 1) Waterproofing/IP tests 2) Vibration and shock testing 3) Thermal performance validation Troubleshoot hardware-related issues across connectors, wiring, and packaging. Support field testing and failure analysis. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Mechatronics / Electrical / Electronics Engineering or related field. 3+ years of hands-on experience in hardware design for rugged electromechanical systems. Strong understanding of: 1) Connectors and harness design 2) IP ratings and sealing techniques 3) Hardware integration in compact systems Proficiency in CAD tools and mechanical design fundamentals. Ability to interpret technical datasheets and standards. Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Experience in UAV payloads, gimbals, or defense/aerospace hardware systems. Knowledge of EMI/EMC design considerations. Familiarity with industrial/military connector standards (MIL-spec). Experience with thermal simulation tools. Exposure to manufacturing processes and vendor coordination.

title: Delivery Account Manager  Automotive Engineering Services For Pune
description:
Role & responsibilities Role Purpose The Delivery Account Manager is responsible for the end-to-end delivery, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and strategic growth of assigned automotive engineering-services accounts. The role serves as the primary bridge between the customer and internal delivery teams, ensuring that engineering programs are delivered on time, within budget, at the expected quality level, and in line with agreed scope, milestones, and service-level commitments. The position combines account governance, delivery leadership, stakeholder management, program oversight, team development, and identification of growth opportunities within existing accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in automotive product development or engineering services, along with the ability to manage complex customer relationships across technical, commercial, and operational stakeholders. Similar roles typically require ownership of delivery performance, resource planning, customer reviews, service KPIs, issue resolution, and account expansion.linkedin+2 Key Responsibilities Account and Customer Management Serve as the primary delivery contact for assigned automotive OEM, Tier-1, Tier-2, or mobility customer accounts. Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across engineering, program management, purchasing, quality, manufacturing, and leadership functions. Understand the customers product roadmap, engineering priorities, technical challenges, delivery expectations, and upcoming business opportunities. Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, translating requirements into clear delivery plans and actions. Conduct regular customer governance meetings, including weekly delivery reviews, monthly operational reviews, and quarterly business reviews. Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication, transparent reporting, and timely issue resolution. Manage customer escalations with urgency, ownership, structured root-cause analysis, and effective corrective-action plans. Delivery and Program Governance Lead end-to-end delivery for multiple automotive engineering programs, work packages, or managed-services engagements. Ensure delivery against agreed scope, timelines, cost, quality, resource plans, milestones, and contractual commitments. Establish and track delivery KPIs, including schedule adherence, milestone achievement, engineering quality, defect leakage, resource utilization, productivity, customer satisfaction, and financial performance. Review project plans, work-breakdown structures, resource plans, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and change requests with project and technical leads. Monitor project health and provide timely status reporting to customer and internal leadership. Identify delivery risks early and drive mitigation plans in coordination with engineering, program management, quality, and functional leaders. Lead resolution of cross-functional issues affecting delivery, including technical dependencies, requirements changes, capacity constraints, quality concerns, and customer approvals. Ensure effective project closure, lessons learned, knowledge capture, and implementation of improvement actions. Engineering and Automotive Domain Leadership Provide functional oversight for automotive engineering-services programs in one or more domains such as: Vehicle engineering and integration Body-in-white, closures, trim, seating, and interiors Chassis, suspension, steering, braking, and dynamics Powertrain, electrification, battery, and thermal systems Electrical and electronics architecture Embedded software, AUTOSAR, diagnostics, and connected vehicles ADAS, autonomous-driving features, and validation CAE, CFD, durability, crash, and simulation Manufacturing engineering, tooling, and industrialization Testing, validation, homologation, and certification Ensure teams follow applicable customer processes, automotive engineering standards, quality systems, and development methodologies. Support delivery compliance with customer-specific processes and relevant frameworks such as APQP, PPAP, FMEA, GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, ASPICE, ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, and functional-safety or cybersecurity practices, where relevant to the engagement. Promote robust engineering reviews, design-quality practices, traceability, configuration management, and documentation discipline. Automotive account leadership frequently spans OEM and Tier customer relationships, cross-functional engineering coordination, program launches, and the management of commercial and delivery issues through the program lifecycle.lamwork+2 Financial and Commercial Management Own account-level delivery financials, including revenue, gross margin, cost, billing, collections support, utilization, and forecast accuracy. Develop and maintain account plans, delivery forecasts, capacity plans, and budget-versus-actual performance. Partner with sales and business-development teams to identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities within assigned accounts. Support preparation of proposals, statements of work, effort estimates, rate cards, resource plans, and commercial presentations. Manage scope changes, change requests, effort variations, and commercial approvals in accordance with contractual and internal governance requirements. Track purchase orders, invoicing milestones, timesheet approvals, billing inputs, receivables, and potential revenue leakage. Support account-growth initiatives through cross-selling, upselling, new service offerings, managed-services conversion, and expansion into additional engineering domains. People and Resource Management Lead and mentor project managers, engineering leads, and delivery teams assigned to the account. Ensure appropriate staffing, onboarding, capability alignment, utilization, succession planning, and employee engagement. Collaborate with resource management and functional leaders to address skill gaps, hiring needs, attrition risks, and ramp-up or ramp-down requirements. Define competency-development plans aligned with customer technology needs and future account-growth priorities. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, quality, innovation, and continuous improvement. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching to delivery leaders and team members. Process Excellence and Continuous Improvement Drive delivery excellence through standardization, automation, reusable assets, productivity initiatives, and lessons learned. Establish and improve account-level dashboards, governance processes, escalation mechanisms, and risk-management practices. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for recurring delivery, quality, or customer-satisfaction issues. Encourage the use of digital engineering tools, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and knowledge-management practices where appropriate. Ensure adherence to internal policies, information-security requirements, confidentiality obligations, and customer data-protection expectations. Prepare and maintain data required for GST returns, TDS returns and other statutory filings. Verify tax deductions and ensure correct accounting of statutory liabilities. Coordinate with consultants, auditors and statutory authorities whenever required. E. Banking & Cash Management Handle day-to-day banking transactions. Prepare bank payment instructions and related documentation. Perform regular bank reconciliations. Monitor bank balances and cash flows. Maintain proper records of cheque, online and other banking transactions. Coordinate with banks regarding routine banking matters. F. Payroll & Employee Accounting Coordinate with HR for monthly payroll processing. Verify salary-related data, deductions, advances and reimbursements. Ensure proper accounting of payroll and employee-related expenses. Assist with statutory deductions and payroll-related compliances. Maintain employee advances and settlement records. G. MIS & Financial Reporting Prepare periodic MIS reports for management. Prepare reports relating to receivables, payables, expenses, cash flow and outstanding balances. Provide financial data and analysis as required by management. Support preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements. Identify discrepancies, unusual transactions and variances and bring them to management's attention. H. Audit & Documentation Coordinate with internal, statutory and tax auditors. Provide required schedules, ledgers, vouchers and supporting documents. Maintain proper filing and documentation of financial records. Assist in responding to audit queries and implementing corrective actions. 3. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related field. Practical knowledge of GST, TDS and basic statutory compliances . Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software such as Tally / ERP systems . Good numerical, analytical and reconciliation skills. 4. Experience 3–7 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts. Experience in handling end-to-end accounting operations independently will be preferred. Candidates with experience in engineering, construction, manufacturing, EPC or project-based organisations will have an added advantage. 5. Strong MS Excel and ERP/accounting software skills. Ability to independently manage multiple accounting activities. Good analytical and problem-solving ability. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality of financial information. Good communication and interpersonal skills. title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
description:
Job Summary The Engine Field Service Technician - Level II is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining, and completing less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites. The role requires a strong customer focus, sound technical knowledge, effective troubleshooting skills, and adherence to Cummins safety, quality, and service standards. The role may be considered for both internal and external candidates , based on relevant qualifications, technical capability, experience, and business requirements. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and complete less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites using approved procedures, service publications, specialized tools, and electronic service tools. Engage with customers in a courteous and professional manner, understand their needs, and provide prompt and effective service solutions. Translate customer complaints into structured troubleshooting plans and identify failed components through appropriate diagnostic methods. Perform preventive maintenance activities in accordance with documented schedules, procedures, and technical standards. Identify, prepare, and use the required parts, tools, equipment, and service information to complete repairs efficiently and accurately. Apply knowledge of engine mechanical and electrical systems, including fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, sensors, controls, and related systems, to diagnose and resolve issues. Validate completed repairs by confirming that the reported issue has been resolved and the equipment is operating as required. Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to experienced Field Service Technicians, technical experts, or the Supervisor, as appropriate. Accurately complete service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality records, and required information in business systems. Maintain accurate customer, equipment, technical, and troubleshooting records to support service history and future diagnostics. Identify additional service opportunities and communicate relevant customer needs to support service excellence. Maintain service vehicles, tools, and equipment in a clean, safe, and operational condition. Complete required technical and developmental training in line with individual skill requirements and business needs. Comply with all applicable Health, Safety Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation, and promptly report incidents, hazards, or other concerns to site management and the Supervisor. Promote a professional, customer-focused, and safety-oriented approach across all field service activities. Key account manager service for HHP segment. Adherence to Service Level Agreement (SLA), HSE guidelines and other business compliance. 1. Have clear understanding of contract scope and discuss with all the concerned at dealership on the commencement of any new contract. 
 2. Support dealership and solution team to prepare an accurate PM schedule. 
 3. Failure trend analysis especially under LHP CAMC and ensure stocking of parts as per FTA through DAMs. 
 4. Ensure the team reviews open SRN regularly and supporting dealership on PM and breakdown SLA compliance. 
 5. Ensure 100 % utilization of contract cap value. Have a monthly review of parts consumption to be tracked and ensure consumption of supplied parts are as per agreed cap value of individual contract. Prepare proactive maintenances and parts replacement in order to prevent breakdowns and share with the customer as per capped value yearly. 
 6. Ensure that vendor evaluation score should be above 95% for all the CAMC customers Develop relationship with customer 1. Prepare and update key / CAMC customer profiles highlighting decision-making positions. Update yearly 
 2. Plan proactive customer engagement and comply. Plan monthly 10 customer / month 
 3. Create 100% activities against all the action points decided in the meeting and track to close as per the agreed timelines. Also keep the customer posted with updates for the Open action items. Within 3 days of the meeting. 
 4. Conduct QBR / MIS with key CAMC customers. Quarterly 
 5. Identify critical success factor of all the key customer in the region and prepare customer support plan accordingly. 
 6. Aim to improve the percentage of customer issues resolved on the first contact, minimizing escalations and enhancing overall customer satisfaction. PM Quality Enhancement 1. ensure that all CAMC service KAMs carryout service quality audits at least for 5 DGs in a month based on 2 previous PMs done and share report with HOD, maintain a tracker with before and after audit status. 
 2. Release consolidated report with findings and improvement plan and track the improvement in processes at dealership. 
 3. Conduct preventative maintenance trainings per dealership. Cover all branches through Area offices KAMs 
 4. Drive seasonal check-ups / maintenance campaigns. -> Seasons / geographical locations 
 5. Audit DG sets older than 10 years through AO KAMs. min 5 DGs / month 
 6. Drive alternator maintenance compliance with all the CAMC customers. Increase in Alternator maintenance SRNs by 20% over previous year. 
 7. Conduct health checks and lube oil sample analysis. Prepare and release an yearly plan and release compliance status monthly. Predictive Maintenance Drive 1. Analyse service data of 5 Key customers in the area at least for last 2 years and identify parts support gaps and failure trend and take proactive measures to prevent the failures for HHP/LHP at key customers. Publish the analysis once in 6 months. 
 2. Identify the engines having clocked more than 5000 hours or 5 years, whichever is earlier and carry out health check ups to demonstrate our value added services to customer. 
 3. Submit RCA of all the failure to the customer within 3 days along with CAPA Key Competencies Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally across different audiences and situations. Customer Focus: Builds positive customer relationships and delivers solutions aligned with customer needs. Diagnostics Troubleshooting: Uses structured troubleshooting approaches, technical information, service tools, and measurements to identify and resolve product issues. Electronic Service Tool Application: Selects and effectively uses appropriate electronic hardware and software tools for diagnosis, maintenance, and repair. Engine Systems Knowledge: Understands the interaction between mechanical and electrical engine systems and applies this knowledge to field diagnostics and repair. Product Repair Maintenance: Performs repairs, maintenance, component replacement, disassembly, and assembly in accordance with approved procedures and quality standards. Service Documentation: Accurately records technical information, troubleshooting activities, repairs, and service outcomes in the required systems. Technical Escalation: Recognizes issues requiring additional expertise and escalates them appropriately while ensuring complete documentation of troubleshooting performed. Health Safety: Demonstrates proactive safety behavior, identifies hazards, follows HSE requirements, and contributes to a safe working environment. Manages Complexity: Analyzes technical information and applies sound judgment to resolve field service issues. Self-Development: Demonstrates a willingness to learn, develop technical capability, and complete required training. Develops Talent: Supports knowledge sharing and contributes to the development of colleagues where appropriate. Values Differences: Works effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and values different perspectives. Qualifications Vocational diploma/certificate from a relevant technical institution. Apprentice-trained Engine Technician qualification is preferred. Locally valid driving permit/license. Any additional technical certifications relevant to engine, mechanical, electrical, or field service activities would be advantageous. The position may require applicable licensing or authorization to comply with export control and sanctions regulations. Skills Basic to intermediate troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for engines and related systems. Ability to use mechanical and electronic service tools and diagnostic equipment. Ability to interpret service manuals, technical publications, diagnostic results, and repair procedures. Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical engine systems. Ability to perform preventive maintenance and less complex repairs independently. Good customer service and interpersonal skills. Ability to accurately complete service reports, warranty documentation, timesheets, and electronic service records. Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work safely and effectively at customer sites. Ability to identify when technical escalation is required. Willingness to travel and work in field/customer-site environments as required. Experience Basic level field service experience is preferred. Intermediate-level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products. Experience in engine maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, or related technical service environments. Customer service experience, preferably in a technical or field service environment. Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical documentation would be advantageous. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a technically capable and customer-focused professional who can independently handle routine field service activities and less complex engine repairs while recognizing when issues require escalation. The candidate should demonstrate strong safety awareness, willingness to learn, disciplined service documentation, and the ability to build effective customer relationships.

title: Python Developer
description:
Job Summary 
 Role Overview We are hiring a Senior Python Developer to build and maintain the Python services in a P C insurance policy administration platform. The platform is moving from a legacy DB2 and IBM i environment toward Python based backend code base, so the work spans maintaining and extending current Python logic against DB2 and building new Python services on the target platform. This is an offshore role delivered from India with a required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. 
 
 Technical Skills 
 6 to 8 years of professional experience building and running production Python 3.x applications. Strong SQL and solid experience with relational databases, including query optimization and working with existing schemas. Sound grasp of OOP, common design patterns, and asynchronous programming (asyncio). Experience building APIs or services with a modern Python framework such as FastAPI (Django or Flask acceptable). Automated testing discipline with PyTest or similar, and version control with Git in a collaborative workflow. Strong debugging, performance-tuning, and analytical skills, with the ability to work in unfamiliar legacy code. 
 
 Essential Skills 
 Good communication and documentation skills. Analytical and problem-solving mindset. Team player with attention to detail. Available to work with 3 to 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. 
 
 Desirable Skills 
 Exposure to PC insurance concepts such as policy, rating, lifecycle transactions, claims and billing. Prior experience delivering for US clients in an offshore or hybrid onshore-offshore model. Exposure to IBM i (AS/400) environments and to DB2 specifically, including reading and connecting to DB2 data. Data-processing experience with Pandas and NumPy. Familiarity with API security including OAuth2. 
 
 Educational Requirements 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Develop, maintain, and optimize Python applications and services, including insurance business logic and scheduled data-processing jobs. Build and maintain Python APIs and services as part of the migration. Write SQL and work across the current DB2 data source including query tuning and data validation. Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code with automated tests (unit, integration, functional) using PyTest or equivalent. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve performance bottlenecks in production systems. Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with US-based client stakeholders, architects, and the offshore delivery team, maintaining 3 to 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. Follow secure development practices across all work, with attention to client data isolation.

description:
Locations : Hyderabad, Telangana, India 
 Role ID 216033 Worker Type Intern - Temporary Employee Studio/Department EA Mobile - Slingshot Games (India) Work Model Hybrid Description Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. Game Design Intern Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India About EA We re EA - home to some of the world s most recognized and loved game experiences. Across mobile, PC, and console, our teams bring together creativity, technology, and a deep understanding of players to build games and experiences enjoyed by millions around the world. EA Mobile creates high-quality, engaging experiences across a diverse portfolio of games and genres. Our Hyderabad studio is one of EA Mobile s largest development centers, bringing together teams across game design, engineering, art, experience design, production, analytics, quality, and live services. Our Game Development teams build and operate live games, create new player experiences, and continuously explore better ways to make games that players love. Our Core Values Tenacity - Hunger to learn, improve, and push boundaries. Ownership - Commitment to your work and delivering meaningful results. Passion - Genuine enthusiasm for games and the craft of making them. Collaboration - Belief that great experiences are built together. Alchemy - Bringing creativity, curiosity, and new ideas to everything you do. Role Overview We re looking for a Game Design Intern who is curious about how games work and excited to learn how great player experiences are designed, built, tested, and improved. As part of a game team, you will work alongside experienced designers and collaborate with disciplines such as engineering, art, experience design, product, analytics, and QA. You ll contribute to real game features and content while developing your skills across systems design, content design, balancing, prototyping, live services, and player-focused problem solving. You ll be encouraged to ask questions, experiment with ideas, learn from feedback, and take ownership of well-scoped design tasks. What You ll Do Support the design of game features, systems, content, and live-service experiences . Turn design ideas into clear flows, rules, requirements, and design documentation. Participate in brainstorming and design discussions , contributing ideas for new mechanics, features, events, and player experiences. Playtest features and content, identify design problems, gather feedback, and iterate on solutions. Work with designers, engineers, artists, experience designers, product managers, analysts, and QA to take ideas from concept toward implementation. Use player feedback, game data, and design principles to understand how features can be improved. Support balancing gameplay, progression, rewards, difficulty, and other game systems. Research games and competitors to understand design patterns, player motivations, market trends, and opportunities for innovation. Contribute to live-service content such as events, challenges, progression experiences, or other recurring player activities. Explore how emerging tools, including AI-assisted workflows , can help improve ideation, research, prototyping, documentation, and iteration. What You Bring A foundational understanding of game design principles , including gameplay loops, player motivation, progression, balance, feedback, challenge, and reward. Strong interest in building games and understanding why players find experiences engaging and fun . Creative and structured problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate ideas clearly through written documentation, diagrams, presentations, or prototypes. Curiosity, willingness to learn, and openness to feedback and iteration. Ability to collaborate effectively with people from different disciplines. Currently pursuing a degree/diploma in Game Design, Game Development, Computer Science, Interactive Media, or a related discipline , or able to demonstrate equivalent skills through personal or academic projects. A portfolio, playable project, prototype, game jam project, level, system design, or other game-design work that demonstrates your thinking and interest in game development. Nice to Have Experience building games through personal projects, college projects, game jams, mods, or internships. Familiarity with mobile or free-to-play games and concepts such as progression, economies, engagement, retention, and live events. Experience using Unity or Unreal to implement prototype gameplay. Experience designing levels, game systems, economies, progression, quests, events, or other game content. A broad interest in different game genres and a habit of breaking down and analyzing the games you play.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Position (Title) : Talent Acquisition Specialist 
Experience Required : 5-8 Years 
Location : Hyderabad 
 Role Overview: We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our HR team and manage end-to-end recruitment across technical and non-technical roles. The ideal candidate should be a strong talent sourcer and stakeholder manager, with the ability to understand business requirements, identify the right talent, manage multiple positions simultaneously, and deliver a smooth candidate experience in a fast-paced environment. 
 Role& Responsibilities: 
 End-to-End Recruitment Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requirement understanding, sourcing, and screening to interview coordination, selection, offer management, and onboarding handover. Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, define candidate profiles, and create effective JDs. Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while meeting agreed hiring timelines and targets. 
 Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, professional networks, and other relevant channels. Use effective Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques to identify relevant talent. Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and upcoming business requirements. Research talent markets and identify new sourcing channels to improve hiring effectiveness. 
 Stakeholder Management Partner with hiring managers and business stakeholders throughout the recruitment process. Conduct regular discussions on hiring priorities, candidate feedback, and pipeline status. Provide timely updates on open positions, interview progress, challenges, and expected closures. Act as a trusted point of contact for candidates and internal stakeholders throughout the hiring journey. 
 Recruitment Operations & Reporting Maintain accurate candidate and recruitment data in the ATS/HRIS. Track recruitment metrics such as Time-to-Fill, Time-to-Hire, Source Effectiveness, Interview-to-Selection Ratio, and Offer Acceptance Rate. Ownership of recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring reports and updates. Ensure recruitment documentation and processes are completed accurately and on time. 
 Candidate Experience & Employer Branding Ensure a professional and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. Maintain timely communication with candidates at every stage of the hiring cycle. Support employer branding and talent attraction initiatives through relevant recruitment campaigns and engagement activities. 
 Required Skills: 
 Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end Talent Acquisition / Recruitment. Proven experience hiring for both technical and non-technical positions. Strong sourcing skills using Naukri, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms. Good understanding of Boolean Search, X-ray Search, and passive candidate sourcing. Strong candidate screening and interviewing skills. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and hiring requirements independently. Strong follow-up, coordination, and negotiation skills. Data-driven approach with an understanding of recruitment metrics and hiring analytics. Experience working with ATS/HRMS platforms. 
 Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 5-8 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment. Experience in a technology-driven or fast-paced organization is preferred.
