title: HR Generalist
description:
SOFTLINK GLOBAL PEOPLE CULTURE HR Generalist (Payroll Compliance) Location: Mumbai (Marol) | Permanent (Full-time) | Experience: 3 to 6 years 
 A quick sense of who you would be joining: Young and fast - Average age is 26. You will support a team that learns quickly and moves quicker. Global by default - Logi-Sys runs in 50+ countries and we are pushing into more. Your work touches a business that crosses global borders every single day. People who stay - Average tenure is 7 years. We build careers here, not revolving doors. Real room to grow - Many of todays leaders started early in their careers and now run the business, coached directly by the CEO. God-view visibility - Work directly with the CEO, CGO, and Chief of Staff. No layers, no filters, no waiting for your ideas to trickle up. 
 The Role We are hiring an HR Generalist who lives and breathes payroll, compliance, and statutory benefits, and who can own the entire employee journey on top of it. Recruitment, business partnering, engagement: all yours. This is not a keep-the-lights-on role. Payroll and statutory are your anchor, but you get something rare: a genuine mandate to rebuild the processes, policies, and systems behind People Ops as we scale past the 50+ countries we already operate in. If you have been waiting for the permission and the platform to fix how HR actually runs, this is it. 
 What You ll Own Payroll (core) - Run the end-to-end monthly payroll cycle for India: inputs, processing, reconciliation, pay slips, and full-and-final settlements. Zero slippage. Statutory compliance (core) - Keep us fully compliant across PF, ESIC, PT, TDS on salaries, gratuity, bonus, Shops Establishments, and every labour register and filing. Statutory company benefits - Administer statutory and company benefits, including group medical cover enrolments, changes, and the employee queries that come with them. Employee lifecycle - Own the full journey from onboarding and confirmations through transfers, records, and exits, with clean documentation at every step. Systems audit-readiness - Keep payroll and HRIS data accurate and reconciled in Keka, and keep us audit-ready for internal, statutory, and certification (including ISO) reviews. Rebuild, don t just run - Take a hard look at our people processes, policies, and systems and make them sharper as we scale. This is the part most HR roles never get to do. Recruitment - Partner in hiring: screening, coordination, scheduling, offer roll-out, and joining formalities. Business partnering - Be the go-to for managers on people matters, policy, and quick, clear query resolution. Engagement culture - Build engagement and culture initiatives alongside the People Culture team. Cross-border - Coordinate with our Philippines team on payroll inputs, benefits, and routine compliance, working alongside the local branch head. Light-touch, not primary ownership of PH compliance. 
 What You Bring 3 to 6 years in an HR generalist or HR operations role, with clear, hands-on depth in payroll and statutory compliance. An MBA / PGDM in HR is required. This is a build-and-lead role, and we want the grounding that comes with it. Keka is mandatory. Hands-on experience running HR and payroll on Keka is non-negotiable. Proven experience on at least one other enterprise HRMS or payroll system: Darwinbox, greytHR, Zoho People, or SAP SuccessFactors. Strong command of the Indian statutory framework: PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, gratuity, bonus, SE, and labour-law filings and registers. The confidence to own the full payroll cycle and statutory calendar on your own, right through audits. A firm grasp of the employee lifecycle and the documentation discipline behind it. Preferred: a background in logistics, freight, supply-chain tech, or B2B SaaS / enterprise technology. Mumbai-based. This is an on-site role in Marol, Andheri (E). We are not considering remote or out-of-city candidates. 
 About Softlink Global Softlink Global is a product-led B2B logistics technology company and the team behind Logi-Sys, a global ERP used by 5000+ freight forwarders, customs brokers, and supply chain operators in 50+ countries. Headquartered in Mumbai with operations across India, the Philippines, and Singapore, we are a growing business now expanding well beyond the markets we already serve, building the software that runs global freight.

title: HR Generalist
description:
":" ProCreator is looking for an HR Generalist / People Operations professional to own and drive core HR operations across the employee lifecycle, while helping strengthen people processes, employee experience, policy governance, and hiring coordination.
 This role is ideal for someone who is hands-on, process-oriented, and comfortable managing day-to-day HR operations independently. The person will play a key role in ensuring smooth onboarding, employee record management, attendance and leave administration, payroll inputs, engagement initiatives, policy execution, and exit formalities. Alongside this, the role will also support recruitment governance and collaborate closely with the recruiter and hiring stakeholders to ensure process adherence and business continuity.
 While the role is primarily an individual contributor position, the person may oversee one recruiter and is expected to step into hiring execution when recruitment volumes or business priorities demand it.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1) Core HR Operations 
 Own end-to-end employee lifecycle administration from post-offer handover through onboarding, active employment, and exits
 Manage employee records, letters, workflows, approvals, and documentation through HR systems, especially Zoho People 
 Handle joining formalities including employment documents, NDA, code of conduct, KYC, bank details, background verification coordination, and induction readiness
 Coordinate with internal stakeholders such as IT for asset allocation, ID creation, access setup, RFID cards, and other onboarding requirements
 Administer leave, attendance, holiday calendars, attendance regularizations, special leave creation, and exception handling
 Provide accurate monthly payroll inputs to the Accounts team and support resolution of employee queries related to attendance, leave, payroll inputs, and employee records
 Maintain HR documentation required for audits, compliance, and insurance-related processes
 
 2) People Processes and Employee Experience 
 Drive probation confirmations, salary revision documentation, promotions, role changes, and related employee lifecycle actions
 Act as a reliable first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, insurance, documentation, and routine employment matters
 Plan and coordinate employee engagement initiatives including birthdays, work anniversaries, festive celebrations, team activities, culture-building efforts, and internal learning sessions
 Support employee well-being initiatives, feedback surveys, POSH-related coordination, and periodic learning and development facilitation
 Ensure a smooth, professional, and employee-friendly HR experience across key people touchpoints
 
 3) Employee Relations and Governance 
 Support managers on policy interpretation, employee discipline matters, notice period discussions, underperformance cases, and other sensitive people issues, escalating when necessary
 Maintain and update employee handbook, leave policy, code of conduct, and day-to-day HR process documentation
 Help strengthen governance by ensuring HR processes are followed consistently and documentation is maintained accurately
 Own HR workflow updates, template changes, automation requests, and coordination with system partners for issue resolution
 
 4) Recruitment Coordination and Business Support 
 Provide recruitment governance support by coordinating hiring intake, role approvals, interview process adherence, and hiring progress tracking with stakeholders
 Partner with the recruiter and hiring managers on offer approvals, parity checks, onboarding readiness, and seamless handover from recruitment to people operations
 Support hiring execution directly during peak hiring periods or when business needs require additional recruitment bandwidth
 Ensure recruitment ownership is approached with flexibility and collaboration, rather than as a rigidly separated function
 
 

 Requirements Must-Have Skills and Experience 
 45 years of relevant experience in HR operations, people operations, or HR generalist roles 
 Strong hands-on experience managing the employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit
 Working knowledge of HRMS platforms , preferably Zoho People 
 Solid experience in onboarding, HR documentation, leave and attendance management, payroll input coordination, and employee records management 
 Ability to independently handle employee queries and routine people operations matters in a timely and professional manner
 Good understanding of HR policies, process documentation, compliance coordination, and governance practices 
 Experience supporting employee engagement initiatives and people experience programs
 Strong coordination skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with recruiters, managers, Accounts, IT, and leadership
 Willingness to support recruitment execution when required by business demand
 Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, process discipline, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment
 
 Preferred Skills / Nice to Have 
 Proficiency in Zoho People and Zoho Recruit for HR operations and recruitment coordination
 Ability to make backend changes, workflow updates, and system-level process improvements in Zoho tools
 Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling HR processes for operational efficiency
 Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption in HR , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools
 Awareness of evolving HR technology trends and the ability to suggest process or system improvements
 Prior experience working in UX/UI, development, branding, creative, or marketing agency environments will be preferred for stronger business and cultural fit
 
 Education 
 Bachelor degree in any discipline
 Relevant work experience and practical HR capability will be valued more than academic specialization
 
 What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days 
 By the end of the first 90 days, success in this role would look like:
 You have taken ownership of day-to-day HR operations and are independently managing core employee lifecycle processes with minimal supervision
 Employee records, onboarding documentation, leave and attendance tracking, and routine HR workflows are well organized and running smoothly in Zoho People 
 Payroll inputs are being shared accurately and on time, with fewer follow-ups or errors
 New joiner onboarding is structured, timely, and well-coordinated across HR, IT, and other stakeholders
 Employee queries are being responded to promptly and professionally, creating a dependable HR support experience
 Key HR documents, templates, and policy/process trackers are updated, easy to access, and better organized than before
 At least a few process improvement opportunities have been identified and implemented across HR operations, workflows, or system usage
 Employee engagement and people experience initiatives are being run consistently with strong coordination and follow-through
 Recruitment governance is running smoothly, with proper coordination between hiring managers, recruiter, and internal stakeholders
 During high hiring periods, you are able to step in and support recruitment execution without losing grip on core HR operations
 You have built trust with employees, managers, the recruiter, and the COO as a reliable owner of people operations
 
 Who You Are 
 Hands-on and dependable, with a strong bias for execution
 Comfortable balancing structure, empathy, and responsiveness in day-to-day HR work
 Process-minded, organized, and able to manage multiple moving parts without losing detail
 Collaborative and practical in approach, with the confidence to work closely with managers and leadership
 Adaptable enough to support both people operations and hiring priorities as needed
 
 

 Benefits This role offers the opportunity to build meaningful impact across people operations in a growing business environment. You will help shape core HR processes, improve employee experience, support managers and teams, and bring structure and consistency to the people function while partnering closely with leadership.
 At ProCreator, were not just offering a job; were providing a platform for you to thrive, grow, and lead. Here what makes us unique:

 Skill Development : Access professional growth funds, learning courses, and mentorship programs tailored to your ambitions. 
 A Work Environment That Inspires: 
 Comfort Redefined: Ergonomic furniture, standing desks, and training for optimal productivity and well-being. 
 Flexibility : We offer the flexibility of working from the office as well as hybrid work arrangements.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Manager Talent Acquisition to lead and manage end-to-end recruitment across junior, mid-level, and senior positions. The ideal candidate should have 8+ years of professional experience, with the majority of their career focused on Human Resources and Talent Acquisition . The candidate should have strong expertise in understanding business requirements, developing effective sourcing strategies, managing stakeholders, and successfully closing positions across different levels of the organization. Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills are essential for this role. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead end-to-end Talent Acquisition processes, from understanding manpower requirements to candidate onboarding. Partner closely with business leaders and hiring managers to understand role requirements, team structures, skill requirements, and hiring priorities. Manage hiring for junior, mid-level, and senior positions , with the ability to independently handle critical and leadership-level mandates. Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies using job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, internal talent pools, campus hiring, professional networks, and other relevant channels. Conduct candidate screening and evaluate candidates based on technical/functional skills, experience, cultural fit, career aspirations, and organizational requirements. Own the recruitment pipeline and ensure timely movement of candidates through the various stages of the hiring process. Drive offer negotiation and closure , effectively managing candidate expectations around compensation, role, location, notice period, and career opportunities. Build strong relationships with candidates throughout the recruitment lifecycle to ensure a positive candidate experience. Work closely with senior stakeholders and hiring managers to provide regular updates on hiring progress, challenges, market availability, and expected closure timelines. Provide insights on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, market trends, and competitor hiring practices to support business hiring decisions. Identify bottlenecks in the recruitment process and implement initiatives to improve Time-to-Hire, Quality of Hire, Offer-to-Joining ratio, and overall recruitment efficiency . Maintain accurate recruitment data, dashboards, MIS, and hiring reports. Mentor and guide junior members of the Talent Acquisition team and support them in managing complex hiring requirements. Contribute to the development and implementation of Talent Acquisition strategies, processes, and best practices . Key Skills & Competencies 8+ years of overall professional experience , with substantial experience in HR and Talent Acquisition. Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment across multiple levels and functions. Proven ability to successfully close both junior and senior-level positions , including niche and critical roles. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with candidates and senior stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills . Excellent candidate assessment, interviewing, negotiation, and closing skills. Strong understanding of sourcing channels and recruitment market dynamics. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective hiring strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to recruitment. Ability to manage multiple hiring mandates and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong ownership, accountability, and execution orientation. Ability to work independently while also mentoring and collaborating with the wider TA/HR team. Preferred Profile MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant qualification is preferred. Experience in a corporate Talent Acquisition / HR environment is preferred. Experience handling leadership, managerial, and critical hiring mandates will be an advantage. Prior experience in managing or mentoring a Talent Acquisition team will be preferred. 
 Success in This Role 
 The successful candidate will be expected to build strong stakeholder relationships, maintain a healthy and high-quality talent pipeline, independently drive complex hiring mandates, and consistently deliver timely and quality closures across levels .

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
":" We are looking for a Technical Recruiter to own end-to-end hiring execution for ProCreator, with a strong focus on creative and technical roles across UI/UX Design, Graphics/Visual design, Product Design, and Frontend/Backend development .
 This role is ideal for someone who can independently drive recruitment from role intake through offer closure and pre-joining engagement, while partnering closely with hiring managers, HR, and leadership. The recruiter will be responsible not just for execution, but also for improving hiring workflows, maintaining strong candidate experience, and contributing to more efficient, insight-led recruitment operations.
 The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience hiring for agency-style and technical environments, understands the nuances of assessing both creative and technical talent, and is comfortable using modern tools and AI-enabled workflows to improve hiring quality and speed.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Talent Acquisition Execution 
 Own end-to-end recruitment for design and technology roles, especially across UI/UX, visual design, product design, and front-end developer hiring.
 Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and create or refine job descriptions, candidate assessments, hiring tasks, and interview questions.
 Publish and manage open roles across ATS platforms, LinkedIn, job boards, social channels, and relevant sourcing platforms.
 Drive proactive sourcing, outreach, screening, and shortlisting of candidates aligned to role requirements and agency-specific expectations.
 Conduct recruiter screening conversations to assess candidate fit across experience, role relevance, communication, motivations, and compensation expectations.
 Manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely movement of qualified candidates through each stage of the process.
 Coordinate assessments, collect submissions, share them with hiring teams, and drive follow-through on interview stages.
 Stakeholder and Candidate Management 
 Schedule and coordinate interviews across stakeholders while ensuring a smooth and timely process.
 Gather structured interview feedback and keep hiring managers aligned on candidate status, risks, and next steps.
 Deliver a strong candidate experience through clear communication, expectation setting, and timely closure at every stage.
 Support offer discussions, compensation alignment, document collection, and candidate negotiation in partnership with HR and leadership.
 Maintain pre-joining engagement with selected candidates to reduce drop-offs and ensure smooth transition until joining.
 Recruitment Operations and Talent Strategy 
 Build and maintain talent pipelines and market maps for recurring or hard-to-fill roles.
 Work with external agencies, campus partners, and niche talent sources when required.
 Maintain ATS hygiene and ensure accurate candidate records, stage tracking, notes, and follow-ups across all active roles.
 Track recruitment metrics such as source effectiveness, funnel conversion, aging positions, and closure timelines, and share insights with relevant stakeholders.
 Contribute to employer branding from a hiring lens through candidate-facing communication, hiring-related content, and brand perception across recruitment platforms.
 Document and improve recruitment workflows, interview scorecards, candidate communication templates, and best practices to support operational efficiency and scale.
 
 

 Requirements 
 Must-Have Skills and Experience 
 45 years of relevant recruitment experience in an in-house, agency, digital, product studio, or tech/services hiring environment . 
 Strong experience hiring for technical and creative roles , especially in areas such as UI/UX, visual design, product design, and front-end development . 
 Ability to independently manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake to offer closure and pre-joining engagement.
 Strong sourcing and outreach capability across multiple channels and platforms.
 Experience partnering with hiring managers to define role requirements and improve hiring quality.
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to drive alignment and momentum across hiring teams.
 Experience managing ATS workflows and maintaining strong process discipline and candidate tracking hygiene.
 Experience coordinating interviews, managing assessments, and ensuring a smooth candidate journey.
 Ability to evaluate candidates on role relevance, functional capability, communication, and compensation fit.
 Experience supporting offer management and negotiation in coordination with HR and business leaders.
 Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, and ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously.
 Preferred / Bonus Skills 
 Experience working with Zoho Recruit ATS .
 Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling recruitment processes for better operational efficiency.
 Prior hiring exposure in a UX/UI agency , digital agency, product studio, or similar fast-paced creative-tech environment.
 Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption within recruitment , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools.
 Awareness of evolving recruitment technology trends and the ability to suggest process, workflow, or system improvements.
 Educational Qualification 
 Bachelor degree in any discipline is acceptable.
 Relevant prior recruitment experience will be valued more strongly than academic specialization.
 What Success Looks Like in 90 Days 
 Takes confident ownership of active hiring mandates across design and technical roles with minimal handholding.
 Builds strong working relationships with hiring managers and establishes credibility through responsiveness, judgment, and process ownership.
 Maintains clean and reliable ATS data, clear pipeline visibility, and disciplined follow-ups across open roles.
 Improves quality and speed of shortlisting through stronger sourcing, screening, and role understanding.
 Creates a smoother and more professional candidate experience across scheduling, communication, and closure.
 Brings structure to assessments, interview coordination, and feedback collection.
 Begins identifying practical opportunities to improve hiring workflows, reduce delays, and strengthen recruitment operations.
 
 
 

 Benefits Benefits
 At ProCreator, were not just offering a job; were providing a platform for you to thrive, grow, and lead. Here what makes us unique: 
 Unmatched Growth Opportunities : 
 Wealth-Building Benefits : ESOPs, Shared Appreciation Rights (SAR), profit-sharing, and referral bonuses to recognize your contributions.

 A Work Environment That Inspires: 
 Comfort Redefined: Ergonomic furniture, standing desks, and training for optimal productivity and well-being. 
 Flexibility : We offer the flexibility of working from the office as well as hybrid work arrangements. 
 Health and Wellness Focus : 
 Comprehensive Health Coverage : Insurance up to INR 5,00,000. 
 Team Bonding Retreats: Strengthen connections and recharge during annual team-building getaways.

title: B2B Sales Executive
description:
Farmiti Agritech Pvt Ltd is a growing India-based technology-enabled business working in Honey, Spices and Natural Food Products , serving both domestic and international markets. Through our business, we work with B2B buyers, distributors, wholesalers, importers and private-label brands and provide solutions including bulk products, private labeling, packaging and brand launch support. We are looking for a motivated and result-oriented B2B Sales & Business Development Executive who can help us grow our customer base across both Domestic and Export markets . Role & Responsibilities Generate and qualify new B2B leads through Phone, WhatsApp, Email, LinkedIn and other channels. Identify potential domestic and international buyers, importers, distributors, wholesalers and private-label businesses. Handle the complete sales process from lead generation follow-up quotation negotiation order closing . Develop and maintain long-term relationships with customers. Handle enquiries for Honey, Spices, Bulk Supply and Private Label products . Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products and solutions. Share product details, company profile, pricing and quotations with potential buyers. Follow up consistently with prospects and existing customers. Coordinate with the internal team for samples, packaging, pricing and order execution. Maintain accurate records of leads, follow-ups, quotations and sales. Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to business growth. Brand Launch & E-commerce Sales: An important part of this role is helping customers who want to start their own Honey or Spice brand . The candidate should be able to understand and communicate our broader solution, which may include: Product Supply + Private Label + Packaging + Branding Support + Website Development + E-commerce Website Therefore, candidates should have a basic practical understanding of Digital Presence and E-commerce , including business websites, online branding and e-commerce platforms. You do not need to be a technical developer or digital marketing expert. You should simply be comfortable understanding and explaining these solutions to potential customers. Candidate Requirements: Fluent Bengali, Hindi, English communication is mandatory. Good spoken and written communication skills. Strong follow-up and negotiation skills. Experience in B2B Sales / Business Development / FMCG / Food Products / Export Sales will be preferred. Comfortable communicating with customers through Phone, WhatsApp, Email and LinkedIn. Basic practical knowledge of Digital Presence and E-commerce . Ability to work independently and manage leads effectively. Target-oriented and self-motivated. Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets. Comfortable handling both Domestic and International customers . Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in B2B sales may also be considered. Work Mode: Currently Work From Home (WFH). As the business grows, the role may transition to an office-based position in Kolkata . Candidates should be comfortable with this future transition. Compensation: 20,000 Fixed Salary per month + Performance-Based Sales Incentives Your earning potential will increase with your sales performance. Who We Are Looking For: We are looking for someone who is not just interested in making calls, but wants to build relationships, generate business and close sales . If you are confident in speaking with customers, good at follow-ups and interested in working across both Domestic and International B2B markets , we would like to hear from you.

title: Vice President  after Sales
description:
Position Title: Vice President of Aftersales
 Department: Aftersales (Service, Parts, and Customer Relations)
 Reports To: Dealer principle/CEO
 Location: Chennai 
 Job Purpose 
 The Vice President of Aftersales provides strategic vision, operational leadership, and financial oversight for the dealerships service, parts, collision repair, and customer care departments. As a key member of the executive leadership team, this role is fully responsible for maximizing aftersales profitability, improving fixed operations absorption rates, and embedding the core Toyota "Customer First" philosophy across all locations to drive lifetime owner retention. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic & Operational Leadership Direct the daily operations of multi-location Service and Parts departments to ensure peak efficiency, modern workflow throughput, and maximum technician efficiency. Implement and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs) aligned with global Toyota Dealer Operation Guidelines to optimize workflow and reduce operational waste. Oversee parts inventory management, utilizing retail inventory systems to balance high fill rates with efficient stock turnover. 2. Financial Performance & Profitability Take full profit and loss (P&L) accountability for all fixed operations, establishing annual revenue, gross profit, and expense budgets. Drive labor sales, parts sales, wholesale growth, and accessory penetration to exceed monthly and yearly financial benchmarks. Analyze daily operational metrics (e.g., effective labor rate, hours per repair order, parts matrix pricing) to implement corrective strategies when needed. 3. Toyota Guest Experience & Retention Champion the Toyota Customer First mindset, continuously tracking and improving the Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) and net promoter metrics. Develop proactive customer retention initiatives, service marketing campaigns, and digital booking strategies to secure long-term brand loyalty. Ensure professional, swift resolution of complex customer escalations, maintaining close communication with regional Toyota distributors. 4. Team Development & Compliance Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing team of Service Managers, Parts Managers, advisors, and technical personnel. Establish training paths to ensure technicians achieve and maintain required Toyota certifications. Enforce strict compliance with local governmental regulations, environmental standards, workplace safety protocols, and factory warranty policies. Required Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Automotive Technology, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is highly desirable. Experience: Minimum of 15 years of comprehensive automotive fixed operations or OEM aftersales experience, with at least 5 to 7 years in a senior executive or multi-site director role. Brand Knowledge: Direct experience managing high-volume Toyota or Lexus aftersales environments, with deep familiarity with Toyota systems, warranty processes, and value-chain operations is strongly preferred. Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in modern Dealership Management Systems (DMS), parts inventory databases, and retail analytics tools. Leadership: Proven track record of managing large teams, driving cross-functional collaboration, and executing successful change management. Role & responsibilities

 Natarajan Empowerment Foundation (NEF) works toward the vision of an empowered India a Viksit Bharat — by enabling women, youth, and senior citizens to realize their full potential. Founded by Dr. Ganesh Natarajan, NEF believes that empowerment is the key to national transformation: giving people the agency to transform themselves, and in doing so, transform India. NEF's work is built on a proprietary five-step framework called "Agency by Design" — Aspiration, Awareness, Action Agenda, Preparedness, and Execution — which systematically builds confidence, skills, and market opportunities for its beneficiaries. Among its core focus areas is women's empowerment , since women make up 48% of India's population but contribute only 18% to its GDP. NEF runs flagship programs such as the IIM Mumbai – NEF Women Leadership Accelerator Program and Success With Scale , an entrepreneurship-focused initiative. Learn more: www.nefconnect.org

This role is central to our mission of empowering women through programs like the IIM Mumbai – NEF Women Leadership Accelerator Program , Success With Scale , and other allied training programs focused on leadership and entrepreneurship development for women. title: Territory Sales Executive
description:
TERRITORY SALES EXECUTIVE - GENERAL TRADE 
 Industry: Imported Glassware / Tableware / Houseware 
 Department: General Trade Sales 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Field Sales 
 Working Days: 6 Days per Week 
 Salary: 26,000 - 45,000 per month + applicable TA/DA/Conveyance at Actuals/ 
 Mobile Allowance. 
 OPEN POSITIONS 
 Delhi / NCR - 2 Positions 
 Territory 1: North Delhi + West Delhi + GT Road Belt up to Ambala 
 Territory 2: South Delhi + East Delhi + Gurgaon + Faridabad 
 Kolkata / West Bengal - 1 Position 
 Territory: Kolkata + Entire West Bengal 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for energetic, street-smart and result-oriented Territory Sales Executives - General Trade to develop the market for a leading Imported Glassware Brand . 
This is a pure General Trade Field-sales role , focused on independent retail outlets such as: 
 Glassware and crockery shops 
 Kitchenware and cookware shops 
 Houseware and plastic household-product stores 
 Gift shops 
 Departmental stores 
 Independent neighborhood / mom-and-pop retailers 
 The sales channel is primarily: 
 Company to Distributor to Retailer to Consumer 
 The role will focus strongly on four areas: 
 DISTRIBUTOR STRENGTHENING 
 OUTLET COVERAGE 
 SECONDARY SALES 
 PRODUCT VISIBILITY 
 This is not a HORECA or Institutional Sales position. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Drive Secondary Sales 
Generate and grow secondary sales from distributors to General Trade retailers. Regularly visit retailers, present products, book orders, introduce new products and generate repeat business. 
The objective is to ensure continuous movement of products from: 
 Distributor to Retailer to Consumer 
 2. Increase Outlet Coverage 
 Continuously identify and develop new retail outlets in the assigned territory. Focus on increasing the number of productive outlets that actively stock, sell and reorder the Imported Glassware Brand. 
 Develop both: 
 New retailers 
 Existing retailers with additional sales potential 
 Approximately 70% focus on new business development and 30% focus on existing business development , depending on territory maturity. 
 3. Strengthen Distributors 
 Work closely with existing distributors to improve: 
 Market coverage 
 Retailer servicing 
 Product availability 
 Secondary sales 
 Stock movement 
 New-product distribution 
 Market penetration 
 Identify areas where distribution is weak or additional distributors may be required. Support the company in identifying suitable new distributor opportunities. 
 4. Improve Product Visibility 
Ensure good visibility and presentation of products at important retail outlets. 
Look for opportunities to improve: 
Shelf placement 
Counter displays 
Product presentation 
New-product visibility 
Range display 
Promotional material 
The objective is to make the products visible and easy for retailers to recommend to customers. 
 5. Increase Product Range Per Outlet 
 Encourage retailers to stock a wider range of products instead of only a few fast-moving items. 
 Focus on: 
 Increasing number of SKUs per outlet 
 Introducing new products 
 Expanding product categories 
 Improving repeat ordering 
 Developing higher-value retailers 
 6. Territory & Beat Management 
 Plan and cover the assigned territory systematically. 
 Develop: 
 Markets - Beats - Retailers - Visit Frequency 
 Maintain disciplined market coverage and regularly identify: 
 New outlets 
 Underdeveloped markets 
 Inactive retailers 
 Distribution gaps 
 Competitor activity 
 New sales opportunities 
 7. Year-on-Year Sales Growth 
 Take ownership of sales growth in the assigned territory. 
 Sales targets will be planned considering: 
 Previous-year sales 
 Existing business 
 Territory potential 
 Outlet opportunities 
 Distributor strength 
 New product opportunities 
 Performance will be strongly evaluated on Year-on-Year sales growth . 
 8. New Product Introduction 
 Actively present and introduce new products to distributors and retailers. 
 The salesperson should be comfortable explaining: 
 Product features 
 Design and usage 
 MRP 
 Retail potential 
 Product dierentiation 
 Consumer appeal 
 9. Market Intelligence 
 Regularly provide feedback on: 
 Competitor brands 
 Competitor pricing 
 New launches 
 Retailer feedback 
 Product trends 
 Retail margins 
 Market opportunities 
 Fast- and slow-moving products 
 Distributor and retailer activity 
 COLLECTION RESPONSIBILITY 
 The Territory Sales Executive will be responsible only for Sales and Market Development . 
 Retailer payment collection will be handled by the respective distributor. 
 IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 
 Experience 
 2 to 5 years of relevant General Trade Field-sales experience preferred. 
 Candidates may come from: 
 Glassware 
 Crockery 
 Tableware 
 Kitchenware 
 Cookware 
 Plasticware / Plastic Household Products 
 Houseware / Homeware 
 Giftware 
 Utensils 
 Small Home Appliances 
 FMCG / Consumer Goods with strong General Trade experience 
 Direct glassware experience is preferred but not mandatory. 
 Strong candidates from Cookware, Kitchenware, Plastic Household Products, Crockery or Houseware are highly relevant. 
 Candidates primarily experienced in HORECA, Hotels, Restaurants or Institutional Sales without meaningful General Trade experience will not be suitable. 
 SKILLS & PERSONAL QUALITIES 
The ideal candidate should be: 
 Strong in General Trade sales 
 Street-smart and energetic 
 Comfortable working extensively in the market 
 Good at retailer relationship building 
 Strong in new outlet opening 
 Experienced in secondary sales 
 Good at distributor coordination 
 Target-oriented 
 Self-driven and disciplined 
 Strong in follow-up 
 Comfortable working independently 
 Commercially aware 
 Willing to travel regularly 
 
 Knowledge of MS Word or Excel is beneficial 
 VEHICLE & TRAVEL 
 Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred / required depending on the territory. 
 The candidate should be comfortable with extensive local travel and outstation travel wherever required. 
 WORKING DAYS 
 This is a 6-day Field-sales position . 
 Weekly off will normally be: Sunday OR the weekly closure day of the principal market being covered. 
 TERRITORY DETAILS 
 NORTH & WEST DELHI / GT ROAD BELT 
 North Delhi, West Delhi and markets along the GT Road belt up to Ambala. Candidates already familiar with retailers and distributors in these markets will be preferred. 
 SOUTH & EAST DELHI / NCR 
 South Delhi, East Delhi, Gurgaon and Faridabad. 
 Existing General Trade market knowledge will be preferred. 
 KOLKATA / WEST BENGAL 
 Based in Kolkata with responsibility for the entire West Bengal market . 
 Regular outstation travel across West Bengal will be required. 
 Knowledge of the West Bengal General Trade market and ability to communicate in Bengali and Hindi will be preferred. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS 
 Performance will primarily be evaluated on: 
 
 Distributor Strengthening 
 Distributor productivity 
 Market coverage 
 Product availability 
 New distributor opportunities 
 Outlet Coverage 
 New outlets opened 
 Productive outlets developed 
 Existing outlet growth 
 New market penetration 
 Secondary Sales 
 Secondary sales growth 
 Year-on-Year sales growth 
 Repeat orders 
 New-product sales 
 Product Visibility 
 Product placement 
 Range visibility 
 New-product displays 
 Retail presence 
 WHO SHOULD APPLY? 
 Apply if you can confidently say: 
 I know General Trade. I can strengthen distributors, increase outlet coverage, drive secondary sales, improve product visibility and grow my territory year after year. 
We are looking for a strong market developer and salesperson , not merely an order taker.

 Urgent Requirement 
 Role & responsibilities 
 BizAarambh Catalyst Pvt Ltd Client is looking for an experienced and target-driven Sales Manager to manage sales growth, develop channel partners, handle key customers, and drive business across ISP, Telecom, IT Networking, Wireless, VoIP, and Enterprise segments. Develop and execute sales plans for the assigned region and product category. Identify new customers, dealers, channel partners, system integrators, ISPs, and enterprise accounts. Manage existing customers and generate repeat business. Drive upselling, cross-selling, and new product sales. Maintain sales pipeline, follow-ups, quotations, order status, and closure reports. Ensure timely customer communication and deal closure. 
 2. Channel Partner and Dealer Management

Conduct partner engagement activities, product discussions, and sales follow-ups. Support partners with product information, pricing, availability, and schemes. Coordinate with the technical team for product selection, compatibility, and customer queries. Promote company key brands and product categories. Understand pricing source, margin, stock availability, and competitor pricing. Participate in product training and ensure team knowledge improvement.

Ensure proper CRM/reporting discipline and timely updates from team members. Train team members on customer handling, product knowledge, communication, and closure. Conduct regular sales reviews and performance discussions. 
 5. Business Development

Work closely with OEMs for product promotion, schemes, and business growth. Lead high-value deal discussions, pricing negotiation, and closure. Track competitor activities and market trends. Follow up for payment, credit approval, dispatch, invoice, and customer confirmation. Ensure proper closure of every task and customer requirement. Avoid pending work without ownership and timeline. Maintain email documentation for important discussions, commitments, approvals, and reports. 
 7. Payment Collection and Compliance 
 Follow company credit policy and payment terms. Ensure timely payment collection from customers and channel partners. Monitor outstanding payments and receivables. Coordinate with the internal team.

 Strong B2B sales and channel sales experience. Good knowledge of IT networking, wireless, telecom, ISP, VoIP, routers, switches, access points, and fiber products. Basic knowledge of CRM, Excel, email communication, and MIS reporting. Ability to work independently and take ownership.

Wireless access points, routers, switches, VoIP/IP phones, fiber networking products, ISP and telecom solutions. title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
 Experience: 4+ years
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Language: Marathi mandatory; proficiency in Hindi and English required 
 About the Role 
 LEADSOURCE TECH is looking for an experienced Regional Sales Manager Maharashtra to develop and grow our business across the state, with a strong focus on Mumbai and Pune. 
 We are specifically looking for someone who understands B2B sales in the Indian market and has experience selling services, technology solutions or other B2B offerings to Indian companies. 
 This is not a purely inside-sales or international lead-generation role . The role requires someone who is equally comfortable prospecting for new business, speaking with decision-makers, visiting customers, attending industry events, building relationships and taking opportunities forward towards closure. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own business development and sales activities for Maharashtra , with primary focus on Mumbai and Pune. Identify and develop new business opportunities across IT and non-IT sectors . Build relationships with business owners, CXOs, IT leaders, functional heads and other key decision-makers. Generate opportunities through field visits, calling, networking, referrals, LinkedIn, exhibitions and industry events . Conduct face-to-face customer meetings to understand business requirements and identify potential technology opportunities. Present LEADSOURCE TECH's capabilities across custom software development, AI, process automation, system integration and digital transformation . Work closely with technical and delivery teams for solution discussions, proposals and customer presentations. Manage opportunities from initial prospecting through meetings, follow-ups, proposals, commercial discussions and closure. Develop long-term customer relationships and identify opportunities for repeat and referral business. Maintain an active sales pipeline and provide regular updates on opportunities, customer discussions and expected closures. Work towards defined sales and revenue targets . Travel within Maharashtra as required for customer meetings, networking and business development. 
 What We're Looking For 
 Minimum 4 years of B2B sales/business development experience. Proven experience selling to Indian companies in the Indian market . Experience combining field sales with direct prospecting and relationship-based selling . Strong understanding of the Maharashtra business environment, particularly Mumbai and Pune . Fluency in Marathi is mandatory , along with good Hindi and English communication. Comfortable independently approaching and meeting new customers. Experience interacting with business owners, senior management and corporate decision-makers. Ability to understand a customer's business problem and connect it with an appropriate technology or service solution. Experience managing opportunities beyond lead generation, including customer meetings, follow-ups, proposals, negotiations and closure. Willingness to travel across Maharashtra as required. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Candidates with experience selling any of the following will have an advantage: 
 IT Services | Custom Software Development | SaaS | ERP | Business Applications | AI & Automation | Digital Transformation | System Integration | Technology Consulting | Other B2B Professional Services 
 Experience selling to industries such as manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, laboratories, engineering, logistics, retail, professional services or other Indian enterprises/SMEs would also be valuable. 
 Important 
 This position is intended for candidates with Indian domestic B2B sales experience . Candidates whose experience has primarily been limited to US/UK/international inside sales, appointment setting, email outreach or lead qualification , without meaningful experience selling directly to Indian businesses, may not be suitable for this role. 
 About LEADSOURCE TECH 
 LEADSOURCE TECH works with businesses to solve operational and technology challenges through custom software development, AI, process automation, system integration and digital transformation . Engineering Clarity. Delivering Impact.

You sell only to inbound online leads. You do not work with brokers or channel partners 100% of your conversions come from leads. End-to-end. You connect, persuade, drive the tour, and close yourself you are a closer, not just a caller. The CRM is your scoreboard. Your performance is measured entirely on what you record and deliver in Zoho CRM.

Qualify & persuade: Understand the seat requirement, budget, location and timeline; build interest and handle objections. Drive the tour: Schedule and ensure the site visit happens, coordinating with the Community / Centre team, and follow through. Coordinate across teams: Work with Community, Operations and Finance for tours, onboarding and agreements. Hit the target: Deliver your monthly seat target of 50 seats and maintain an accurate, healthy pipeline.

Persuasion & Negotiation: Moves a lead from interest to signed handles objections and negotiates commercials confidently within approved limits. Interdepartmental Coordination: Works smoothly with Community / Centre Managers for tours and with Ops & Finance for onboarding and agreements. Competition Knowledge: Knows the competing coworking brands, pricing and positioning and can clearly pitch the IA Spaces advantage. CRM Management: Disciplined in Zoho CRM – every lead, call and stage updated accurately, so the CRM is the true record of performance. 
 Experience & Eligibility Experience: 1–4 years in tele-sales / inside sales with a proven record of personally closing deals over the phone (real estate, coworking, ed-tech, insurance, BFSI or similar). Target orientation: Self-driven and comfortable being measured on the Attempted Connected Tours Closures funnel.

title: Deputy General Manager Digital Marketing
description:
Deputy General Manager Digital Marketing Performance Marketing | Digital Growth | AI-First Search | Content Location: Bengaluru 
 Reporting To: Sr.VP & Business Head Experience: 7 to 12 years 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About Deeksha Vedantu Deeksha Vedantu brings together Deekshas established academic strength and Vedantu’s digital learning capabilities to create an integrated learning ecosystem for students. As the organization continues to scale, digital is becoming an increasingly important engine for brand discovery, student acquisition, engagement and admissions. Role Purpose We are looking for a high-ownership, performance-oriented digital marketing professional to join us as Deputy General Manager – Digital Marketing. Reporting to the Head of Growth, the role will independently own the day-to-day digital marketing agenda across performance marketing, search, AI-led discovery, SEO, content, analytics and conversion optimisation. The role is designed for a strong digital operator who can translate business objectives into measurable campaigns, manage agencies and partners, work hands-on with platforms and data, and continuously improve the efficiency and quality of digital acquisition. Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing & Digital Acquisition Own and execute performance marketing strategy across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube and other relevant digital channels. Manage Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Display, remarketing and lead-generation campaigns. Build full-funnel acquisition plans covering awareness, consideration, lead generation, counselling and admission. Optimise CPL, cost per qualified lead, CAC, lead-to-counselling conversion, counselling-to-admission conversion and ROAS/ROI. Develop campaign strategies by geography, class, course, examination, audience and intent. Continuously test new channels, formats, audiences, creatives and messaging. 2. AI-First Search, AEO & GEO Develop Deeksha Vedantu’s approach to the rapidly evolving AI Search and discovery ecosystem. Drive initiatives across Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and AI-search visibility. Improve discoverability across Google’s AI-led search experiences and relevant AI discovery platforms. Build strategies around conversational search, long-tail intent, topical authority, entities and structured content. Understand the questions and decision journeys of students and parents across traditional search and AI platforms. Create a measurable framework to track visibility, authority and referral opportunities from AI-led discovery. 3. SEO & Organic Growth Own the organic search strategy across Deeksha Vedantu’s websites and digital properties. Drive technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, local SEO, internal linking, structured data and authority-building initiatives. Develop search-intent and keyword strategies aligned to courses, examinations, locations and student/parent needs. Increase organic traffic, search visibility and organic lead generation through a structured growth roadmap. 4. Content Marketing Own the digital content strategy in collaboration with academic, creative and content teams. Build content engines around JEE, NEET, CBSE/State Boards, Classes 11–12, careers, college choices and academic guidance. Develop content for reach, engagement, search, trust and conversion. Build a content ecosystem that works across Search, YouTube, Social, AI Search, Website and lead-generation funnels. Use search, audience and performance data to continuously refine content themes, formats and distribution. 5. Landing Pages & Conversion Optimisation Own the conversion journey beyond traffic acquisition. Improve landing pages, lead forms, CTAs, WhatsApp journeys, website conversion and mobile experience. Identify funnel drop-offs and develop hypotheses to improve conversion. Drive A/B testing of messaging, creatives, landing pages, offers and user journeys. 6. Analytics, Attribution & Performance Intelligence Build a robust digital measurement framework using GA4, advertising platforms, CRM and business data. Establish reliable source-to-lead and source-to-admission attribution. Develop dashboards covering leads, qualified leads, CAC, conversion, admissions, revenue contribution and ROI. Move optimisation beyond CPL towards qualified leads, admissions and revenue outcomes. Use data to identify incremental growth opportunities and improve digital budget allocation. 7. AI, Automation & Marketing Technology Identify practical opportunities to use AI across campaign optimisation, audience research, content, SEO/AEO/GEO, reporting and personalisation. Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve marketing speed, quality and efficiency. Evaluate emerging marketing technologies that can improve acquisition, lead quality and conversion. Champion an AI-first mindset within the digital marketing function. 8. Agency & Stakeholder Management Manage external agencies, partners, freelancers and specialist vendors where required. Set clear KPIs, SLAs, budgets, reporting standards and performance expectations. Work closely with the Head of Growth, business teams, academic teams, creative/content, admissions and technology/product teams. Ensure timely execution, transparent reporting and accountability across all digital initiatives. 9. Digital Budget Management Support annual and monthly digital marketing planning in alignment with the Head of Growth. Recommend channel-wise budget allocation based on performance, incremental opportunity and business priorities. Forecast acquisition outcomes and proactively identify risks, opportunities and corrective actions. Maintain strong control over digital marketing efficiency and return on investment. Key Performance Indicators Qualified leads and cost per qualified lead Customer acquisition cost (CAC) Digital-attributable admissions and revenue Digital contribution to admissions ROAS / marketing ROI Organic traffic, organic leads and search visibility AI Search / AEO / GEO visibility Website and landing-page conversion rate Lead-to-admission conversion Incremental growth delivered through digital channels Candidate Profile Must Have 7–12 years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing or digital growth. Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads. Demonstrated experience managing meaningful digital advertising budgets. Strong understanding of performance marketing funnels and lead-generation businesses. Strong analytical capability and comfort working with campaign and funnel data. Working knowledge of GA4, attribution, CRM-based measurement and reporting. Strong understanding of SEO, content marketing and conversion optimisation. Experience managing agencies and/or digital marketing teams. Preferred Experience in EdTech, education, consumer internet, D2C or another high-consideration category. Experience with large-scale lead-generation campaigns. Experience with YouTube performance marketing. Working knowledge of AEO, GEO and AI Search. Experience using AI tools and automation in marketing workflows. Experience building content-led acquisition engines. Experience connecting marketing metrics to admissions, revenue or other business outcomes. The Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a builder and operator who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. They should be performance-led, analytical, commercially minded, curious about AI, comfortable with data and willing to challenge existing approaches through experimentation. What Success Looks Like Success in this role will mean building a disciplined, measurable and scalable digital marketing engine for Deeksha Vedantu — with stronger paid acquisition efficiency, clearer attribution, improved conversion, growing organic discovery and a credible presence across traditional and AI-led search environments.

Doctor Engagement: Arrange CMEs and get-togethers for Ayurvedic doctors, including end-to-end planning, vendor coordination, on-site setup, and hosting this is a hands-on execution role, not just planning from a desk. Product Launches & Packaging: Collaborate on go-to-market strategy for new product lines target audience research, pricing, and packaging text and take ownership of execution through to shelf/market readiness. Ground Events & Activations: Plan, set up, and personally attend local wellness expos and seminars to connect directly with consumers includes physical setup, stall management, and being present on-site for the full duration of the event. Sales Team Coordination: Coordinate closely with the existing Sales Team across various locations aligning marketing activities with ground sales priorities, sharing market/competitor feedback, supporting them with collateral and doctor/customer engagement, and ensuring marketing execution is synced with what sales teams are seeing on the ground. Performance Tracking: Manage a modest marketing budget effectively, track ROI on activations/events, and optimize strategies based on real ground-level results. Competitor Analysis: Keep a regular track of competitor activity, starting with identifying actual competitors category-wise, and translate findings into actionable inputs for sales and product teams. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, Sales, and Manufacturing teams to ensure marketing plans are practical, executable, and aligned with ground realities not just theoretical plans. 
 Note: This is a hands-on role the Marketing Manager is expected to personally execute activations, doctor engagements, and events on ground, working in close coordination with the Sales Team, rather than only overseeing strategy remotely. Required Skills & Qualifications: 
 Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Pharmacy, or Life Sciences. A certification or deep foundational knowledge in Ayurveda/herbal science is a massive plus. Experience: 710 years of proven marketing experience at a senior level, ideally within the ayurvedic, wellness, FMCG, herbal, or organic skincare space. Prior experience working within a small business or founder-led environment is highly preferred, along with a demonstrated track record of personally executing (not just planning) ground activities such as events, launches, or field campaigns. Domain Knowledge: Solid grasp of basic Ayurvedic terminology, herbs, and standard health/regulatory compliances relevant to Ayurvedic and herbal products. Execution & Field Readiness: Comfortable working hands-on at the ground level setting up stalls, coordinating with vendors and doctors on-site, and troubleshooting on the spot rather than only directing from an office. Soft Skills: Excellent storytelling and copywriting capabilities, an agile problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work cross-functionally with R&D, Sales, and Manufacturing. Coordination: Proven ability to align and coordinate effectively with existing, geographically spread-out sales teams to ensure marketing plans translate into on-ground results. Travel: Willingness to travel extensively across North India covering locations old and new, wherever the existing Sales Team and Supply Chain are present, as well as new markets.

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
About FIAB Finance in a Box is an accounting and financial consulting firm based in California, providing outsourced CFO and controller services to companies around the world. FIAB operates as one managed operating partner for finance, HR, and regulatory readiness for growing businesses. FIAB recently expanded beyond finance into HR services through its partnership with GyroHR, and is preparing to launch FinOpz, an AI-enabled finance operations platform, as a new product line alongside its core services business. 
 The Role Were looking for a Senior Marketing Manager / Marketing Lead to build and run marketing for Finance in a Box, as a hands-on, individual-contributor role working closely with FIABs fractional CMO. Youll personally plan, write, run, and measure campaigns, own the marketing side of our CRM (HubSpot), lead nurture campaigns, build our LinkedIn and thought-leadership presence, and work side-by-side with BD/Sales to turn marketing activity into a measurable pipeline. Youll also take on product marketing support for FinOpz, our new AI-enabled finance operations platform, as one part of a broader, all-around marketing role rather than a dedicated product marketing seat. Youll meet weekly with the fractional CMO to set priorities and review work, and use freelancers or agencies as extra hands, not as a substitute for your own execution. 
 Responsibilities Campaigns demand generation Own multi-channel campaign execution (LinkedIn, email, content, webinars/events) that generates qualified leads for priority segments. Manage the marketing side of our CRM (HubSpot): email nurture campaigns, list segmentation, and reporting, in coordination with BD/Sales on lead handoff and pipeline feedback. Partner with BD/Sales on account-based approaches for target accounts and joint go-to-market plans. Track leads through the funnel and report results and ROI to leadership. Brand content Build and personally drive our LinkedIn presence and thought-leadership content: founder posts, articles, case studies, and market commentary that build credibility across finance and HR/people-ops circles. Translate FIABs finance, HR, and expanding service offerings into clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for different buyer personas. Own website updates, one-pagers, decks, and sales-enablement content, working with leadership and BD. Track competitor positioning and market developments in fintech/finops, and B2B services to keep messaging sharp and current. Product marketing (FinOpz) Take on product marketing support for FinOpz as it moves through beta and toward public launch, coordinating with the fractional CMO on strategy and priorities. Process vendor management Build repeatable marketing processes, calendars, SOPs, and playbooks, proactively identifying and fixing gaps rather than running campaigns ad hoc. Brief and manage external agencies, freelancers, or contract designers/copywriters, holding them accountable for quality and deadlines while retaining ownership of strategy and outcomes. Meet weekly with the fractional CMO to set priorities, review work, and course-correct. 
 What Youll Need 10-12+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong track record in demand generation, not just brand or communications. Genuinely fluent with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as a core part of how you work, not an occasional add-on. Youll be a team of one and need to multiply your own output. Hands-on experience running the marketing side of a CRM/marketing automation platform (HubSpot strongly preferred): nurture tracks, list management, and reporting. Proven experience building LinkedIn presence and thought-leadership content for a B2B brand or leader. Experience working closely with BD/Sales on pipeline generation, lead handoff, and account-based approaches. Comfortable marketing technology, recruitment/HR, or financial and professional-services offerings to sophisticated B2B buyers. A bias for personal execution: comfortable writing copy, building campaigns, and getting into the details rather than only directing others. Data-driven mindset: able to set up and read funnel metrics and adjust tactics based on results. Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, or contractors to deliver on brief and on time. Strong written communication skills in English, with real editorial judgment on what AI-assisted drafts still need before theyre ready to ship. A self-starter who takes a loose direction and turns it into a concrete plan, and builds process and structure proactively. 
 Nice to Have Experience marketing a new product launch, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience as the first or sole marketing hire in a growing services or technology business. Familiarity with account-based marketing motions alongside demand generation. Comfort with design/no-code tools (Canva, basic Figma, website CMS) to move quickly without always relying on a designer. Exposure to both US and India B2B buyer contexts. Experience working alongside a fractional or outside CMO/marketing advisor. Required Skills Branding CRM BD experience HubSpot Marketing

Review accounting entries and identify discrepancies. Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities. Ensure proper accounting documentation and record maintenance.

Maintain records of invoices, credit notes, debit notes, and receipts. Track outstanding receivables and coordinate for timely collections. Manage TDS calculations, deductions, payments, and return-related activities . Maintain proper records for GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements. Track statutory due dates and ensure timely compliance. Coordinate with the CA/Tax Consultant for tax filings, assessments, and other compliance matters. Support statutory and tax audits by providing required documents and information. 
 4. Financial Reconciliation & Reporting Perform bank, vendor, customer, GST, and TDS reconciliations. Identify and resolve outstanding and unreconciled transactions. Prepare periodic accounting and financial reports. Prepare MIS and other reports as required by management. Provide accurate financial information for management decision-making. 
 5. Payroll Knowledge Added Advantage Basic understanding of payroll accounting will be an advantage. Knowledge of salary-related accounting, statutory deductions, PF, ESIC, or Professional Tax will be preferred. Payroll experience is not mandatory , as the primary responsibility of this position is Accounts and Compliance. 
 6. Audit & Documentation Prepare schedules and supporting documents for internal, statutory, and tax audits. Coordinate with auditors, Chartered Accountants, consultants, and internal teams. Maintain proper digital and physical records of accounting and compliance documents. Ensure financial and statutory documents are accurate and readily available.

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping . Good working knowledge of Tally/Accounting ERP and MS Excel . Knowledge of GST and TDS is required. Good understanding of bank reconciliation, ledger reconciliation, billing, and financial reporting. Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently manage accounting activities and statutory deadlines. Good communication and coordination skills. 
 Preferred Candidate Candidates with experience in service-based, manpower/staffing, or contract-based organizations will be preferred. Experience in handling multiple client/vendor accounts will be an advantage. Knowledge of payroll and labour-related compliances is an added advantage, not mandatory . Candidate should be capable of independently handling day-to-day accounting and compliance activities. 
 Key Competencies Accounting | Bookkeeping | GST | TDS | Billing | Bank Reconciliation | Ledger Reconciliation | Tally/ERP | MS Excel | Statutory Compliance | Taxation | Audit Support | MIS Reporting

Handle month-end/year-end closing activities, including accruals, depreciation, forex accounting and GL reconciliations. Process domestic and foreign remittances, employee claims, travel advances and settlements. Manage banking and treasury activities , including bank reconciliations, cash-flow monitoring, fund transfers, foreign currency transactions, Fixed Deposits and FIRC follow-up. Handle GST compliances , including input tax credit, RCM, monthly/annual requirements, GST refund claims and coordination for GST assessments/notices. Coordinate statutory, tax, GST and other audits, including preparation of schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation. Manage employee timesheet reconciliations and related PMO coordination. Prepare Purchase Orders/Work Orders and support finance-related vendor activities. Maintain finance records and documentation and ensure adherence to company policies and applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate with banks, auditors, tax consultants, LIC, ERP support providers and other external stakeholders as required. Support other Finance & Accounts activities assigned from time to time. Candidate Criteria Qualification CA Inter/CMA Inter preferred along with B.Com/M.Com.

Preference for candidates from IT/ITES, shared services, service/export-oriented organisations or similar corporate environments . Candidate should have independently handled a meaningful portion of the finance function rather than having experience restricted to only AP, AR or bookkeeping. 
 Essential Experience / Skills Strong hands-on accounting and month-end closing experience. Working knowledge of GST, TDS and other statutory compliances . Experience in AP/AR, banking, payments and reconciliations. Experience in audit coordination and preparation of audit schedules. Good working knowledge of Excel and accounting/ERP systems. Ability to independently coordinate with banks, auditors, consultants and internal stakeholders. Good communication, documentation and follow-up skills. 
 Preferred / Added Advantage Experience with SOFTEX, STPI, FIRC, AD Bank and RBI-related export compliance . Experience in GST refund claims, assessments/notices and annual returns . Exposure to treasury/Fixed Deposit management and foreign remittances. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV/Navision or similar ERP . Experience in payroll reconciliation and statutory payments.

title: Accounts Executive
description:
Location: Coimbatore (Onsite) Experience: 2 - 4 years (Hands-on) 
 
 Job Summary 
 Were looking for a hands-on Accounts Executive who can independently manage day-to-day bookkeeping, compliance, and reporting for a growing consulting firm serving global clients. Youll work closely with leadership to keep the books accurate, compliance timelines met, and financial reporting audit-ready. Youll take ownership of the full accounting cycle-from transaction entry to PL and balance sheet reporting-while coordinating statutory filings and payroll-related compliance across multiple organizations/entities under our umbrella. If youre detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable owning numbers end-to-end, this role is for you. Were a firm thats constantly picking up new tools, so youll fit right in if you enjoy figuring out a better, faster way to do something rather than sticking to the same process out of habit. Given that youll be handling sensitive financials across multiple entities, this is a role built on trust - someone we can hand the numbers to and not have to double-check. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Maintain books of accounts for multiple entities/organizations in parallel, keeping each set of records distinct and audit-ready. Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping and ledgers in Zoho Books . Perform regular expense reconciliations (bank, vendor, and credit card). Prepare and maintain the Chart of Accounts . Prepare PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets for management review. Track and report on cash flow , flagging shortfalls or timing gaps proactively. Process payroll accurately and on time, including statutory deductions. Maintain Asset Management records (fixed assets, depreciation schedules). Handle GST and TDS computation, payment, and return filing (including quarterly TDS filings). Ensure compliance with Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment registrations and renewals. Support Income Tax related filings and coordination with auditors/consultants. Manage client and vendor invoicing , including follow-up on outstanding receivables. Handle multi-currency transactions (USD billing) and reconcile FX conversions. Support audit requirements by preparing schedules and responding to auditor queries. Keep records in Zoho Books clean and consistent, so reports and dashboards stay reliable. Use AI tools to improve accuracy and speed of recurring accounting tasks. Maintain clear, professional written communication with internal teams, vendors, and clients over email. 
 
 Early Impact 
 Weeks 1-2: Understand our accounting systems, chart of accounts, compliance calendar, and ongoing processes. By ~60 days: Independently manage bookkeeping, reconciliations, and routine compliance filings with minimal supervision. By ~90 days: Own the monthly close process end-to-end, including PL/Balance Sheet preparation, and proactively flag compliance deadlines, cash flow gaps, and budget variances before theyre asked about. 
 
 Must-haves 
 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Accounting and Bookkeeping. Proven experience managing books for multiple organizations/entities simultaneously , keeping each set of accounts separate and accurate. Strong working knowledge of Zoho Books (or equivalent accounting software). Proficiency in Excel (formulas, reconciliations, reporting). Practical experience with GST and TDS compliance, including quarterly TDS filings. Experience preparing PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets . Good understanding of cash flow - tracking inflows/outflows and anticipating shortfalls. Experience maintaining a Chart of Accounts . Experience with payroll processing and statutory deductions. Experience with Asset Management (fixed asset tracking, depreciation). Working knowledge of Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment compliance. Comfort using AI tools to support accounting workflows. Strong written communication skills, especially over email. Someone who takes ownership of the numbers, follows through without needing reminders, and is comfortable being the person others can rely on when it matters. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a consulting or services firm billing international clients. Exposure to Income Tax filings and audit coordination. Experience working directly with external auditors, CAs, or compliance consultants. Experience handling client/vendor invoicing and receivables follow-up. Exposure to multi-currency accounting , particularly USD billing and FX reconciliation. 
 
 Skills 
 Zoho Books Excel AI Tools GST TDS Income Tax Bookkeeping Multi-Entity Accounting Expense Reconciliations PL Balance Sheets Cash Flow Projections Budgets Chart of Accounts Payroll Processing Asset Management Professional Tax PF Gratuity Shop Establishment Compliance Client Vendor Invoicing Multi-Currency Accounting Audit Support Written Communication 
 
 Educational Qualifications 
 We care more about the quality of your work and thinking than specific degrees. A strong track record in similar roles matters most.

description:
