This opportunity is ideal for fresh graduates who are passionate about digital maps, location-based services, GIS, navigation, and data analysis . The role involves working on Point of Interest (POI) information across digital mapping platforms while ensuring high levels of accuracy, quality, and customer experience. General Guidelines Registrations will be processed on a first-come, first-served basis. Participation is limited to the first 350 eligible candidates reporting between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM. Personal laptops, tablets, or other electronic devices are not permitted during the interview process. Candidates are advised to carry a mobile charger as the interview and assessment process may extend throughout the day. Applicants must be Graduates or Postgraduates. Candidates currently pursuing full-time education are not eligible. The role operates in a 24x7 work environment supporting global customers and requires flexibility to work in rotational shifts and rotational week-offs. Immediate joiners will be preferred. Eligibility Criteria Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 6 Months of experience. Bachelors or Master’s degree in any discipline. Basic understanding of maps, geography, GIS, navigation, or location-based services. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Willingness to work in rotational shifts. Key Responsibilities Review, validate, and update Point of Interest (POI) information on digital mapping platforms. Verify business information such as name, address, phone number, category, operating hours, and geographic coordinates. Perform map data quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Research location data using reliable online and public sources. Identify duplicate, incorrect, and outdated map information and recommend corrections. Support geocoding and reverse geocoding activities. Analyse mapping issues and escalate complex cases when required. Meet daily productivity and quality targets. Maintain compliance with project guidelines, quality standards, and service level agreements (SLAs). Collaborate with internal teams to improve data quality and operational efficiency. Mandatory Skills Basic knowledge of Digital Maps and Navigation Systems Point of Interest (POI) Understanding Data Validation and Verification Research and Analytical Skills Attention to Detail Internet Research Basic MS Excel Communication Skills Quality Orientation Problem Solving Preferred Skills Knowledge of GIS concepts and mapping technologies. Exposure to GIS tools such as ArcGIS or QGIS through academics, projects, or internships. Basic understanding of geocoding and location intelligence concepts. Knowledge of SQL or data analysis tools will be an added advantage. Certification in GIS, Remote Sensing, or Geospatial Technologies is desirable but not mandatory. Preferred Candidate Profile Strong focus on accuracy and quality. Curious mindset with excellent research capabilities. Ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly. title: Assistant Manager HSE
description:
Position:- Asst. Manager HSE Exp - 4-7 years Job Purpose To drive the continual development and maturity of Sodexo Safety Culture and Safe Behaviors by demonstrating safety leadership behaviors and embedding the Group Zero Harm Mindset initiatives. Deploy the implementation of the APMEA Food and Health and Safety Processes across all sites, Adaption of APMEA processes, where required, into Country / Local Processes to check legal compliance within country /area of responsibility. The overall mission is to deliver safe and compliant work solutions for operations teams providing services. This will be achieved by operationally implementing APMEA HSE systems and procedures and where required, identify any policy and or procedure gaps or omissions or variations required. Also assist in the development of HSE solutions specifically for our clients. Roles and Responsibilities 
 Make sure deployment of Zero Harm mindset within frontline employees. Make sure Safety improvement plan action implemented at site/ account. Confirm deployment of Sodexo Safety Net and Client Safety initiative at site / account. Food Safety Responsible of overall upkeep, food hygiene and safety standards of the location. Monitor activities through out food chain for upkeep of Food safety standards. Risk Assessment - Identify the potential risk related to working environment, machinery or equipment and suggest the preventive measure to site manager. Prepare Risk Assessment & Risk Register. Update risk assessment post incident or new scope addition. Train all frontline staff in hazard identification and reporting. Communicate risk assessment to staff. Legal Register - Prepare and update Legal Register. Make sure all legal compliance in place and escalate in case of Non compliances. Safety Walk and Safety Observation - Conduct safety walks and Safety Observation. Report in Salus system and track for closure Near Miss - Create awareness on Nearmiss reporting and report Nearmiss in Salus Incident Management - Inform regional HSE & region Head. Investigate the incident and Prepare RCA along with Site Manager and team. Make sure all root causes corrective actions implemented at site. Share Incident learning with site teams, HSE Practices - Make sure adherence to Time temperature, FIFO, Sorting Process, Thawing, salt & Turmeric processes, CCPs, Deep Cleaning, Pest Control, PPM of Equipment, Electrical Safety, Global engineering practices, HSMS processes. Documentation - Monitoring that all checklists and records are maintained. Cleaning Checklist, Pest Control Records, 11/ A-L files, Temperature records, COA, E-guarantee form, Invoices etc. Escalate in case of repeated deviations. HSE Trainings -Prepare Training Matrix. Inform site manager in advance of planned training (TBT, Quick Share, Campaign, regular training etc.). Conduct HSE induction for new joiners. Make sure compliance to Training Matrix update Site wise Training Tracker. Training compliance to be tracked as per training calendar in training tracker. Upload training details to Access system. Safety Campaigns -Plan and arrange the various safety motivation program such as safety day celebration, safety contest to motivate and spread awareness among the staff. Calibrations - Verify that calibration of equipment e.g., thermometer probe, GLD, weighing balance, pressure gauge is being carried out on defined frequency. Conduct Self inspection and Safety declaration monthly and track and close all reported gaps / observations. HSE Audit Findings - Follow, track and Coordinate with site manager, region head and client for closures. Escalate in case of overdue. Food Sample Retention - Periodically verify the sample and freezer temperature. Report deviation to site manager and escalate in case sample are not retained. Mobilization Framework – Make sure HSE mobilization framework includes MOB 03, BCP, ERP, Communication Board, PPE matrix, HSE Files and Folders, HSE induction training, HSE Accountability, Risk Assessment, Hazard Analysis, SOP implementation. Follow up for due diligence points with client or vendor or region head. Subcontractor Management- Co-ordinate with Site Leads and SCM and make sure subcontractor Management processes are implemented across all sites. Monitor vendor partner’s activities for the compliance on food & Health and Safety practices. PPE Compliance - verify that all staff are using the required PPE while performing the task. Provide list and quantity of required PPE. Prepare PPE matrix. Raise negligence issues with region head. Report negligence issues in Access HR. Lab Testing - Coordinate with site manager and verify that periodic external food and water testing is being done. Review test report for suitability and make sure samples are send as per sampling plan SNAG list - Provide inputs related to snag points. Follow-up with site manager & client for closure. Participate in joint discussion with client for snag. Review health condition of equipment and suggest for rectification and addition of safety feature, if required connect with regional purchase or client. Miscellaneous – Food Inspector Visit - Inform Regional HSE and Regional Head. To provide compliance documents. Co-ordinate with food testing lab for testing (reference sample). Obtain COA, invoice of sample. Review the existing SOP and recommended corrections Support for BCP Review and Audit, MMR and QBR Data support, Emergency Response and Mock Drill at site / account. Job Requirements Qualifications

description:
Job Title: Clinical Data Manager Experience: 3-5 Years
 Location:- Ahmedabad, WFO. 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 Job Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Clinical Data Manager with 3-5 years of experience in clinical data management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing clinical trial data throughout the study lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, accurate, and compliant data. The role involves database design review, data validation, query management, data cleaning, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to support successful clinical study execution. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end clinical data management activities for assigned clinical studies in accordance with project timelines. Review study protocols and contribute to the design and review of electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), edit checks, and clinical databases. Perform data validation, discrepancy management, and query generation/resolution to ensure data quality, consistency, and completeness. Develop and execute data cleaning strategies, including routine data review and reconciliation activities. Review clinical trial data for accuracy, integrity, and compliance with study protocols, SOPs, client requirements, and regulatory guidelines. Coordinate database User Acceptance Testing (UAT), database updates, and database lock activities. Generate data listings, reports, metrics, and study status summaries for internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Medical Monitoring, and external vendors to resolve data-related issues. Review and maintain Data Management Plans (DMPs), Data Validation Plans (DVPs), CRF Completion Guidelines, and other study documentation. Support medical coding activities using MedDRA and WHO Drug dictionaries, where applicable. Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, CDISC standards, SOPs, and applicable regulatory requirements. Participate in audit and inspection readiness activities and address data management findings. Prioritise workload effectively to meet project milestones and deliverables. Mentor or guide junior Clinical Data Management associates, as required. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Nursing, or a related discipline. 3-5 years of experience in Clinical Data Management within a CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environment. Experience working with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems such as Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm, Veeva EDC, or similar platforms. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, database management, and data cleaning methodologies. Knowledge of ICH-GCP, CDISC (CDASH/SDTM), and regulatory guidelines. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications. 

 Required Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data quality. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Ability to manage multiple studies and prioritise competing deadlines. Strong interpersonal and cross-functional collaboration skills.
